blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: This document presents a comprehensive account of my practical and theoretical work over the past year, serving as a written report. A work dedicated to the field of natural language processing ( NLP ) for the global health domain, one domain of a multi-disciplinary nature that is found at the intersection of various fields such as: healthcare, global politics and decision-making, social sciences, economics, etc. After having conceptualized the nature of this domain, one can imagine the large quantity of literature frequently published by different professionals and numerous organizations located all around the world with the goal of tackling each global health challenge. One of the crucial objectives of this published literature is to enhance inter-connectivity and foster mutual understanding among all entities that work on the domain.
blocks.zh: 本文件全面叙述了我过去一年中的实际和理论工作,作为一份书面报告。 专为全球卫生领域的自然语言处理领域(NLP),一个多学科领域,存在于保健,全球政治和决策,社会科学,经济学等各个领域的交汇处. 在对这个领域的性质进行概念化分析之后,人们可以想象世界各地不同专业人员和众多组织经常出版的大量文献,目的是应对每一项全球卫生挑战。 这份已出版的文献的关键目标之一,是增进相互联系,促进所有从事该领域工作的实体之间的相互了解。

blocks.en: As a principle, mutual understanding has one core concept in it’s meaning, human language. Broadly, natural language processing is defined as a set of methods that makes human language accessible to computers. It is situated in the neighbourhood of computational linguistics, machine learning, and artificial intelligence. This neighbourhood offers a variety of tasks for an emerging interdisciplinary field such as the chosen one, supported by tools laying in the thin line between text mining and natural language processing [ 1 ].
blocks.zh: 作为原则,相互理解在意义上有一个核心概念,即人类语言. 广义地说,自然语言处理被定义为一套能使计算机获取人类语言的方法. 它位于计算语言学、机器学习和人工智能的邻近地区。 这个街区为新兴的跨学科领域,如所选领域,提供各种任务,辅以在文本挖掘和自然语言处理之间的细线上铺设的工具[1].

blocks.en: From a large variety of tasks and applications of NLP, we will be focused on ones that analyze linguistic structures based on form (morphologically), meaning (semantically), sentence structure (syntactically), and word usage (lexically). This project can be categorized as a contribution to NLP applications, particularly in the fields of text mining, information retrieval, and document categorization, all of which are essential for healthcare and knowledge systems worldwide [ 2 ].
blocks.zh: 从NLP的大量各种任务和应用中,我们将侧重于分析基于形式(形态学),意义(学),句子结构(学),和单词使用(学)的语言结构. 这一项目可归类为对NLP应用的贡献,特别是在文本挖掘、信息检索和文件分类等领域,所有这些对全世界的保健和知识系统都至关重要[2]。

blocks.en: Specifically, this thesis delves into the realm of information retrieval, employing word2vec for tag similarity discovery, studying the impact of corpus size on the process. Document categorization involves a taxonomic classification of tags, assigning multiple tags to sentences using a multi-label AI model. Last but not least, Named Entity Recognition takes center stage, extracting essential entities from publications.
blocks.zh: 具体来说,这篇论文探索了信息检索领域,用字2vec来标记相似性的发现,研究了生物体大小对过程的影响. 文件分类涉及标签分类,使用多标签AI模型为句子分配多个标记. 最后但并非最不重要的是,命名实体确认会占据中心位置,从出版物中提取重要实体。

blocks.en: 1.1 Motivation & Industry Need
blocks.zh: 1.1 动力和工业 需求

blocks.en: In this next chapter, I would like to identify my motivation behind the choosing of this topic, a motivation fueled by two main reasons, a personal one and an academical one. Reasons that drove me to the proposal of this topic to my supervisors.
blocks.zh: 在下一章中,我想指出选择这一专题背后的动机,这一动机是由两个主要原因促成的:个人原因和学术原因。 促使我向上级提出这个话题的原因

blocks.en: Personally, since the first day I became part of this domain through an internship at Geneva Digital Health Hub , I could observe a common theme in it’s knowledge base and the ones of it’s global partners such as WHO 1 1 1 World Health Organization , incomplete annotations going through a process of human annotation. This remark of data quality is especially delicate in cases where we are dealing with a graph knowledge base, such as was my case with neo4j , where accurate annotations are vital to ensuring efficient retrieval, data representation, and contextual analysis. This isn’t an isolated phenomena of my experience as a developer, but rather a general industry need that tends to be more delicate in the global health domains and healthcare systems. Acknowledging the expertise and authority of domain experts in human annotation, it also becomes imperative to free their time from data preparation, allowing them to concentrate more on providing care and facing global challenges [ 3 ].
blocks.zh: 从个人角度来说,自从第一天我在日内瓦数字健康中心实习成为这个领域的一部分以来,我可以观察到它的知识库中的一个共同主题,以及它的全球伙伴,如世界卫生组织111, 不完整的说明正在经历人类的注释过程。 这种对数据质量的评论在我们处理图表知识库时特别微妙,例如我处理Nea4j时,准确的说明对确保有效检索、数据表述和背景分析至关重要。 这不是我作为开发者经验的孤立现象, 承认域专家在人文注释方面的专长和权威,也有必要腾出时间编制数据,使他们能够更集中地提供护理和面对全球挑战[3]。

blocks.en: Having expressed that, I would like to mention the second main part behind my motivation. A part born of a pure academic interest to dive deeper into the field of NLP after having taken both courses of our masters related to it, courses given by Dr. Tanja Samardžić. Explicitly, formulating and analyzing a research hypothesis, comparing state of the art to my custom methods, and exploring the literature for each one of the above mentioned topics.
blocks.zh: 在表达了这一点之后,我要提及我动机的第二部分。 由Tanja Samardžić博士教授的课程, 明确提出和分析研究假说,比较艺术现状与我的定制方法,探讨上述每个专题的文献.

blocks.en: To recap, the combination between a systematic theoretical review of the project’s NLP topics and the development of a potential finished annotation pipeline able to be deployed in a real-world industrial environment, served as catalysts behind my choice. Let us move on to the next final introductory chapter where a general organization of the thesis will be provided.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,对项目的NLP专题进行系统的理论审查与开发一个有可能在现实世界工业环境中部署的已完成的注解管道相结合,成为我所选择的催化剂。 接下来是最后一章,在该章中将提供一个论文的一般组织。

blocks.en: 2 word2vec Tag Discovery
blocks.zh: 2个字2vec 标签发现

blocks.en: We will begin with the task of utilizing word embeddings as a system of tag discovery. This task should be viewed as the prologue of the project’s workflow, one that studies one of the integral parts of NLP, embedding words to a low-dimensional vector representation that can be mathematically manipulated to our task’s desires.
blocks.zh: 我们首先将使用嵌入词作为标签发现系统。 这项任务应被视为项目工作流程的先驱,即研究NLP的一个组成部分,将文字嵌入到低维矢量的表示中,这种表示可以被数学操纵到我们的任务的欲望中。

blocks.en: 2.1 Word Embeddings
blocks.zh: 2.1 嵌入词

blocks.en: To present it simply, word embeddings map multiple thousands of words in a mathematical space that positions them corresponding to their semantic properties. Subsequently, the mathematical similarity of these positioned continuous vectors is conjectured to the real semantic similarity that words share with each other in human language [ 4 ].
blocks.zh: 简单来说,单词嵌入在数学空间中映射了数以千计的单词,这些单词的位置与它们的语义性质相对应. 随后,这些定位连续向量的数学相似性被猜想为在人类语言中词与词彼此共享的真实语义相似性[4].

blocks.en: The power of neural networks to learn complex patterns and capture non-linear relationships in the data reflected in their accuracy to also capture the complex linguistic nuances in our languages. Moreover, neural methods turned out more adaptable than traditional ones when considering that these nuances and relationship between linguistic elements differs for every language. In addition to that, the raw superiority in computational power and efficiency to process large amounts of text corpora made them even more of a suitable choice. As a consequence, neural network based representations have almost fully replaced the traditional conventional count-based methods [ 5 ].
blocks.zh: 神经网络在数据中学习复杂规律和捕捉非线性关系的能力,体现在其准确性上,也能够捕捉我们语言中复杂的语言细微差别. 此外,当考虑到每种语言的语言要素之间的这些细微差别和关系不同时,神经方法比传统方法更能适应。 除此之外,在计算能力和效率方面原始优越性,可以处理大量的文本corpora,使得它们更适合选择. 因此,基于神经网络的表达方式几乎完全取代了传统的常规计数方法[5].

blocks.en: 2.2 Data Preparation
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 数据编制

blocks.en: Before building the word2vec model in itself, a data preparation process was made. This should be a given fact knowing that the model needs a predefined vocabulary in which it will be trained and learn to map it to the corresponding continuous vector space. The vocabulary is build from the given raw text corpus while our custom tag discovery process is achieved by querying each element of another predefined set of tags. Therefore, in the next two sub-chapters, we will proceed to specify these two segments required before training the model.
blocks.zh: 在建立单词2vec模型本身之前,进行了数据准备过程. 这应该是一个特定的事实,知道模型需要一个预先定义的词汇,在其中将接受培训并学习将其映射到相应的连续矢量空间. 词汇是从给定的原始文本库中构建的,而我们的自定义标签发现过程则通过查询另一套预定义标签的每个元素来实现. 因此,在接下来的两个分章中,我们将在培训模型之前具体确定这两个部分。

blocks.en: 2.2.1 Initial Tags
blocks.zh: 2.2.1 初始标记

blocks.en: The preliminary set of tags was extracted from the knowledge base of Implementome , a global digital health knowledge management platform released by gdhub 6 6 6 Geneva Digital Health Hub , a platform in which I was part of the developing team.
blocks.zh: Gdhub 6 6 6 Geneva Digital Health Hub发布的全球数字健康知识管理平台Uppleome的知识库中提取了初步的标签,我是开发团队的一部分。

blocks.en: Formally, these tags were named concept tags and added as an optional property to the global digital health publications stored in the database. Therefore, each publication was manually being annotated with one or more of these tags by a given global health expert part of the team. This detail motivated me to incorporate the automatic multi-label topic classification study into this project, with the goal of increasing data quality.
blocks.zh: 在形式上,这些标签被命名为概念标签,并作为可选属性添加到存储在数据库的全球数字卫生出版物中. 因此,每一份出版物都由小组的某个全球卫生专家部分用一个或一个以上标记作手动说明。 这一细节促使我将自动多标签专题分类研究纳入这一项目,目的是提高数据质量。

blocks.en: Another important factor that went into my consideration was the fact that the knowledge base was structured in graphs, through neo4j as a graph database management system. A correct high quality data representation is vital in graph-based management as it heavily influences the effectiveness of processing and information retrieval and leads to better long-term scalability [ 9 ].

blocks.en: For the final labels that will pass to the topic classification pipeline, I opted out for a final clear distinct set of tags that represents somewhat of a taxonomy, albeit not official. Knowing that the publications in this domain encompass a wide range of other domains –with tags ranging from from specific parasitic diseases to financing options, political agendas, modern technologies, and beyond–, the diverse nature of tags poses a significant challenge and underscores the crucial need for a filtering process.
blocks.zh: 关于最后的标签,我选择了最后的一套明确而不同的标签,这些标签在某种程度上代表了分类学,尽管不是官方的。 由于认识到这一领域的出版物包括广泛的其他领域 — — 标签从具体的寄生虫病到融资选择、政治议程、现代技术以及以后 — — 标签的多样化提出了重大挑战,并突出了过滤过程的迫切需要。

blocks.en: Apart from a cleaning up process that removed incorrect or abundant data, my general filtering process was based on the following principles:
blocks.zh: 除了清除不正确或大量数据的清理过程外,我的一般过滤过程基于以下原则:

blocks.en: • Detecting Synonyms ⇒ \Rightarrow Instances of multiple tags representing the same concept were combined into one. For example: outbreak + + epidemic + + pandemic + + virus ↦ \mapsto epidemic • Removing Named Entities ⇒ \Rightarrow Initially, named entities (e.g. UNAID , Switzerland , LMICs ) were incorporated into the concept tags. They were filtered out given that their detection will be included in a pipeline of its own and I wanted to drive the tags towards a taxonomy of global health document categorization topics. • Disease Instances ⇒ \Rightarrow Recognition of disease instances (e.g. hypertension , pneumonia , leishmaniasis ) in a publication will be a custom pipe part of the named entity recognition model, therefore the task is shifted from topic classification and such instances were removed. • Refining WHO’s Classification ⇒ \Rightarrow Some instances of DHI’s classification are viewed to be a bit redundant and hence can result in an unnecessary overlapping during classification. Such thought instances were also consolidated into a single representation. For example: health information + + health data analytics + + electronic health records ↦ \mapsto electronic health records • Merging unigrams to bigrams ⇒ \Rightarrow Multiple unigram tags were merged into bigrams representing their hierarchical parent in terms of domain. This grouping improves the overall clarity of the concept tags, allowing a more inclusive classification of publications. For example: pressure + + anxiety + + stress + + ptsd ↦ \mapsto mental_health

blocks.en: 2.3 word2vec Pipeline
blocks.zh: 2.3个字2vec 管道

blocks.en: Both original model architectures presented in the word2vec paper [ 7 ] needed to be studied before proceeding with actual implementation. Continuous Bag-of-Words (CBOW) and Continuous Skip-gram are the pair architectures designed to efficiently learn distributed representations of words with minimal computational complexity while maximizing the probability in equation (2) , as an indication of their language modelling ability. Although very similar in their common objective and training complexity with regard to total vocabulary size N N , the two differ in terms of network design:
blocks.zh: 在着手实际实施之前,需要对2vec字面论文[7]中提出的两个原始示范架构进行研究。 连续Bag-of-Words(CBOW)和连续September-Skip-gram是一对架构,旨在高效地学习最小计算复杂性的单词分布式表现,同时最大限度地增加方程式(2)中的概率,以此表示其语言建模能力. 虽然两者在词汇总大小NN上的共同目标和培训复杂性非常相似,但两者在网络设计上有所不同:

blocks.en: The CBOW architecture predicts the current word based on the context, and the Skip-gram predicts surrounding words given the current word. [ 7 ]
blocks.zh: CBOW架构根据上下文预测当前单词,Skip-gram根据当前单词预测周围单词. [7]

blocks.en: As observed, CBOW sums up and averages the context words w c w_{c} within a custom window to predict the target word w w , hence maximizing: P ⁡ ( w | w c ) P(w|w_{c}) . Reversely, Skip-gram is given the target word w w , to predict the context words w c w_{c} around it. Its objective is to maximize P ⁡ ( w c | w ) P(w_{c}|w) instead.
blocks.zh: 正如所观察到的,CBOW在自定义窗口中汇总和平均上下文词w c w_{c}以预测目标词w w,从而最大化:P (w|w_{c}) P(w|w_{c}). 反之, Skip-gram 被赋予目标词 w w , 以预测周围的上下文词 w c w_{c 。 其目标是实现PQQ(w c |)P(w_{c}|w)的最大化.

blocks.en: Skip-gram was chosen as the model for our tag discovery task given that it excels in capturing semantic relationships, while CBOW excels in syntactic relationships [ 16 ]. This is simply because words that occur in a similar context tend to have a similar meaning and we also want to study the effect of variations in context presented by our corpora.
blocks.zh: Skip-gram被选为我们标签发现任务的模型,因为它在捕捉语义关系方面表现优异,而CBOW在合成关系方面表现优异[16]. 这仅仅是因为发生在类似语境中的词语往往具有相似的含义,我们还想研究我们公司在语境中呈现的变化的影响.

blocks.en: 2.3.1 Text Pre-Processing
blocks.zh: 2.3.1 文本处理前

blocks.en: After having chosen Skip-gram as the architecture, the implementation process started. Gensim was chosen as the working framework, being the most popular Python library for unsupervised topic modelling, document indexing, and similarity retrieval with large corpora. Moreover, it offers a specialized word2vec training function that requires a list of sentences constituting the entire corpus in addition to the model’s hyperparameters. Prior to specifying those, we need to address the sequence of pre-processing steps involved in transforming a folder of PDFs into a curated train list of sentences constituting the corpora.
blocks.zh: 在选择Skip-gram作为架构后,执行过程开始了. Gensim被选为工作框架,是最受欢迎的Python库,用于无监督的专题建模,文档索引,以及与大公司公司相似的检索. 此外,它还提供一种专门的单词培训功能,除了模型的超参数之外,还需要一份构成整体的句子清单。 在具体说明这些内容之前,我们需要解决将一个PDF文件夹转换成构成Corpora的列车的句子清单所涉及的预处理步骤的顺序问题。

blocks.en: PDF Parsing:
blocks.zh: 专题报告 解析 :

blocks.en: PyPDF2 is the open-source library used to read each PDF file in order to convert it to a text file. It extracts the main data from documentations into a text format, therefore skipping any tables or graphics that the document may contain. The extracted text from all publications constituting a corpus was saved in a single text file, creating the raw text corpus.
blocks.zh: PyPDF2是用于读取每个PDF文件的开源库,以便将其转换成文本文件. 它从文档中提取主要数据到文本格式,从而跳过文档可能包含的任何表格或图形. 从构成实体的所有出版物中提取的文本被保存在一个文本文件中,创建了原始文本库。

blocks.en: Text Normalization:
blocks.zh: 文本正常化 :

blocks.en: As any other raw text corpus, the produced corpus text file needed to go through a normalization process before any natural language processing is made [ 17 ]. Specifically, the normalization function included: separation of the text into sentences, lowercasing, removal of unnecessary numerical digits or special characters, punctuation removal, and a final tokenization process to break each sentence into a sequence of discrete word tokens.
blocks.zh: 与任何其他原始文字汇编一样,制作的文字汇编在进行任何自然语言处理之前,需要经过一个正常化过程[17]。 具体地说,正常化功能包括:将文本分为句子,降级,去掉不必要的数字或特殊字符,点缀去除,以及将每个句子分解成一组离散词符的最后的符号化过程.

blocks.en: To ensure the quality of the training data, an additional criterion was introduced to filter out sentences without a substantial contribution to the training. Only lists of sentences that surpassed a predefined threshold of word count were retained, thus eliminating shorter sentences that might represent parts of publications such as: titles, references, or headlines.
blocks.zh: 为确保培训数据的质量,引入了一项补充标准,在未对培训做出实质性贡献的情况下,对判决进行过滤。 仅保留了超过预先确定的字数阈值的句子清单,从而删除了可能代表出版物部分内容的较短句子,如标题、参考资料或头条。

blocks.en: Automatic Phrase Detection:
blocks.zh: 自动词组检测 :

blocks.en: After having normalized and tokenized the raw text corpus in order to obtain a refined set of sentences and consequently a clearer context w c w_{c} for each word w w , a final pre-processing step was implemented. Specifically, a phrase detector to combine unigram tokens to bigrams or trigrams, given that a multitude of our concept tags are of the same nature.
blocks.zh: 在使原始文字规范化并作标记之后,为了获得一套精细的句子,并因此对每个词 w w 的上下文更加明确 w c w_{c}, 执行了最后的预处理步骤。 具体来说,一个将unigram符号与bigrams或trigrams结合的词组探测器,因为我们的许多概念标记具有相同的性质.

blocks.en: The main objective of it is to learn frequent co-occurrences of pairs of words and merge them into one unique token, embedded in one unique vector [ 18 ]. Its implementation is offered in gensim however I modified it by choosing Normalized (Pointwise) Mutual Information (NPMI) as the scoring function between words instead. This choice was based on its demonstrated better performance [ 19 ], in addition to the improved results it provided in my experiments. Notably, I found that most of the automatic merges made sense semantically and resembled a potential bigram (or trigram) tag.
blocks.zh: 其主要目标是学习频繁的对子词的共化,将它们合并为一个独特的符号,嵌入一个独特的矢量[18]. 其执行以gensim形式提出,然而我修改了它,选择了规范化(Pointwise)的相互信息(NPMI)作为单词之间的评分功能。 这一选择是基于其表现较好[19],以及在我的实验中提供的改进结果。 我发现大部分的自动合并都有意义,

blocks.en: This concept of scoring measures the co-occurrence of two words in comparison to their individual occurrence probabilities P ⁡ ( w 1 ) P(w_{1}) and P ⁡ ( w 2 ) P(w_{2}) in addition to the joint probability of observing the two words together P ⁡ ( w 1 , w 2 ) P(w_{1},w_{2}) . The negative logarithm of the joint probability in the denominator normalizes the final score to the range [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] in order to obtain a more readable score and clearer threshold.
blocks.zh: 这一评分概念衡量了两个单词与其单个发生概率P (w 1)P(w_{1)和P⁡(w 22)P(w_{2)的共发性,此外还有将两个单词合在一起观测的概率P⁡(w 11,w 22)P(w_{1),w_{2}). 分母中联合概率的负对数使最终得分正常化到幅度[0,1] [0,1],以获得更可读的得分和更明确的阈值.

blocks.en: 2.3.3 Tag Discovery
blocks.zh: 2.3.3 标签发现

blocks.en: The main goal of word2vec, as outlined in Mikolov’s seminal work [ 7 ], is to map similar words to similar continuous representation vectors. Therefore, our theoretical intention to discover new tags by examining the vectors that are most similar to the vector of the initially queried concept tag could proceed, upon reaching the end of training. Each element part of the constructed vocabulary V V of words was mapped to vectors of dimension 500 500 for each corpus. Cosine similarity is used to measure the cosine angle between vectors and provide a measure of similarity, that ranges from − 1 -1 to 1 1 :

blocks.en: 2.4 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 2.4 评价

blocks.en: When evaluating a word embedding neural model such as word2vec, it is important to categorize each assessment into intrinsic or_and extrinsic. Intrinsic evaluators test the quality of a representation independent of NLP tasks by measuring it’s ability to capture linguistic meanings and represent language patterns accurately. On the other hand, extrinsic evaluators use word embeddings as input to a practical specific downstream NLP task, estimating its performance on real world applications [ 22 ].
blocks.zh: 在评价一个嵌入神经模型的单词如word2vec时,必须将每个评估分为内在或_和extrinsic. 内在评价员通过测量其准确捕捉语言含义和代表语言模式的能力,测试独立于NLP任务的代表质量. 另一方面,外部评价人员使用嵌入词作为实用的下游NLP任务的投入,估计其在现实世界应用上的性能[22].

blocks.en: To properly evaluate such a model, especially in the case of unsupervised corpora such as ours, it is important to test it in both categories [ 23 ]. Therefore, we will proceed with multiple scoring functions that are part of both categories, starting with the model comparison in terms of training time. blocks.en: 2.4.1 The Odd One Out
blocks.zh: 2.4.1 奇异现象

blocks.en: We will begin with an intrinsic evaluation method called the odd one out . As the name suggests, it corresponds to finding the odd word out of groups of four randomly shuffled words. Each word group was hand-crafted by me through the word embeddings generated from a test set corpus, separated by our other corpora. Specifically, a random word was selected from the vocabulary V V and the list of its most similar vectors was generated, akin to the tag discovery task. From the list, two randomly selected words among the top 10 most similar words were added to the group. Finally, another word from lower down the list was chosen (the odd one), thereby creating a scenario to identify the odd one out.
blocks.zh: 我们首先要用一种内在的评价方法, 如名称所示,它相当于从四个随机洗牌单词组中找到奇异的单词. 每个词组都是由我手工制作的 通过一个测试程序生成的词组 由我们另一个公司分离出来的 具体来说,从词汇V V中选择了一个随机的单词,并生成了它最相似的矢量列表,类似于标记发现任务. 从列表中,在前十名最相似的单词中,两个随机选择的单词被添加到组中. 最后,从列表下方选择了另一个单词(单词),从而创造了一种识别单词退出的情景.

blocks.en: 1000 instances of these word groups were created with the objective to challenge the models’s abilities to understand semantic and syntactic relationships by identifying dissimilar words. This is part of linguistic feature understanding thus categorizing this assessment function as intrinsic [ 24 ].
blocks.zh: 创建了1 000个这些单词组,目的是通过识别不同的单词来挑战模型理解语义和合成关系的能力。 这是语言特征理解的一部分,从而将这一评估功能归类为内在[24].

blocks.en: Surprisingly, word2vec models trained with our small specialized corpora performed better for this task than the large pre-trained biomedical one. This observation can be explained from the fact that the testing set derived from the same corpus as the training set, both sharing similar contexts. As a result, a bias can be introduced, one that leads to a better performance and understanding for the specialized models. Despite that, the average accuracy scores are still lower than initial expectations. The random selection manner in which the word groups were formed might have created a certain amount of confusing instances, consequently leading to a more challenging problem for all models. In future research, a hand-curated careful selection of word groups might be a more coherent supervised evaluation. All in all, it was still an interesting evaluation method to create and study, as a small semantic understanding challenge for the models.
blocks.zh: 出乎意料的是, 与我们小的特种部队一起训练的Word2vec模型 完成这项任务的成绩 优于大型的生物医学预训模型。 之所以提出这一看法,是因为测试集与培训集来自同一体系,两者背景相似。 因此,可以引入一种偏差,一种偏差会导致专业模型更好的性能和理解. 尽管如此,平均准确分仍然低于最初的预期. 组合词的随机选择方式可能造成一定数量的混乱情况,从而给所有模型带来更具挑战性的问题。 在今后的研究中,用手工精心挑选词组可能是更协调一致的监督评价。 归根结底,作为模型的一个小语义理解挑战,创建和研究仍然是一种有趣的评价方法.

blocks.en: Having discussed the language understanding and predictive abilities of our models, we will now employ an extrinsic evaluation method to investigate the impact of corpus size for our research question. This evaluation method focuses on the practical application part of this task, tag discovery with regard to cosine similarity.
blocks.zh: 在讨论了我们模型的语言理解和预测能力之后,我们现在将采用一种外部评价方法,调查体积对我们研究问题的影响。 这种评价方法侧重于这一任务的实际应用部分,关于余弦相似性的标记发现.

blocks.en: Therefore, we will compare the similarity query results of our filtered set of tags across each corpus to determine the corpus that provides the most relevant and semantically similar new tags. Hence, this is a subjective comparative evaluation where people are asked about their preferences among different word embeddings [ 22 ], rather than an absolute mathematical evaluation such as the methods described above. If the exact tag as written on our set is not present in the vocabulary constructed by the model, the query result will be empty since there is no corresponding vector for that tag. Thus, let us observe how the corpora differ on this small but crucial detail.

blocks.en: It should be noted that the results were selected from the first 20 most similar words with regard to the queried tag, therefore the top 20 most similar vectors in terms of cosine similarity. It should be carefully observed how our models trained on specialized corpora, albeit not very generalizable to all tasks, have been adapted to our task of finding similar tags in terms of semantics and similar surrounding context.

blocks.en: While the pre-trained BioWordVec model captures absolute true synonyms and overlapping n n -grams (e.g. Violence ↦ \mapsto Gun Violence ) with a high c ​ o ​ s ​ i ​ n ​ e ≥ 0.85 cosine\geq 0.85 score, our models equipped with a small specialized corpora capture similar words that would appear in the same context (e.g. Tobacco Use ↦ \mapsto Nicotine Addiction ). This exact feature allowed us to discover new tags that may not initially seem semantically similar yet are mapped to similar vectors a cause of appearing in similar context. The main reasons behind this difference between the specialized embeddings and the pre-trained ones are purely architectural. Skip-gram aiming to maximize predictions of similar contexts allows us to use the latter to find similar target words while also learning dissimilar ones due to negative sampling. Therefore, it can also be seen as somewhat of a fine-tuning of word2vec to our tag discovery task.
blocks.zh: 虽然预训的BioWordVec模型捕捉绝对真实的同义词和重叠的n -gram(如暴力 \\ mapsto Gun Violence),且得分很高的c o i n e 0.85 cosine\geq 0.85分,但我们的模型配备了小型专业的corpora捕获到类似词语,这些词语会出现在相同的上下文(如烟草使用 \\\\ mapsto Nicotine成瘾). 这个确切的特性使我们能够发现一些新的标记,这些标记最初可能看起来并不完全相似,但被映射到类似的矢量上,成为类似上下文出现的原因。 专业嵌入器与预训嵌入器之间这种差异的主要原因是纯粹的建筑设计. Skip-gram旨在最大限度地预测类似的环境,使我们能够利用后者来找到类似的目标词,同时学习由于负面取样而不同的词。 因此,它也可以被看作是一个微调 字2vec 我们的标签发现任务。

blocks.en: Regarding the differences between the models trained within my selection of corpora, we can observe the parallelism in performance and corpus size through the performance of the model trained on 100 Books . In further work, I would propagate further the size of it, while staying true to the specialized context of global digital health to avoid the generalizations seen in the results of pre-trained embeddings.

blocks.en: Apart from the study, the results of this process allowed me to enrich the existing set of tags in order to create a hierarchical representation of them. One that would aid me in having an equally distributed taxonomy of labels during the topic classification part of this project.

blocks.en: 3 Named Entity Recognition
blocks.zh: 3 名称实体识别

blocks.en: Named entities are crucial in any knowledge management system, especially in those dedicated to global health that are built with the objective of sharing knowledge and connecting people, patients, professionals, shareholders, organizations, and even countries, globally. Therefore, the submission of accurate and high-quality named entities, free from any missing data, serves as a critical foundation for achieving seamless interconnectivity. This fact served as my main motive behind my choice to make named entity recognition the central focus of this project.
blocks.zh: 命名的实体对任何知识管理系统都至关重要,特别是那些致力于全球卫生的实体,这些系统旨在分享知识,将全球人民、病人、专业人员、股东、组织乃至国家联系起来。 因此,在没有任何缺失数据的情况下,提交准确和高质量的命名实体,是实现无缝互联的关键基础。 这一事实成为我选择让被点名的实体承认这一项目中心重点的主要动机。

blocks.en: Standing as one of the most important sub-fields of global NLP research, Named Entity Recognition (NER) is a classical problem in information extraction, able to recognize and extract mentions of named entities in text [ 29 ]. These can usually be people, locations, organizations, and geopolitical entities, as presented below through visualizing an element of one of the most historically renowned NER datasets, CoNLL-2003 [ 30 ].
blocks.zh: 作为全球NLP研究最重要的子领域之一,命名实体识别(NER)是信息提取中的一个古典问题,能够识别和提取文本[29]中对命名实体的提及. 这些通常是人、地点、组织和地缘政治实体,通过将NER数据集中的一个要素直观化,CONLL-2003[30]。

blocks.en: Recently, the NER task has been expanded to include amounts of money, percentages, dates, times, etc. Most importantly, it has been revealed as a key task in biomedical NLP, given the custom labelling of proteins, DNA, RNA, cell lines, diseases, medications, organisms, mutations, as entity types [ 29 ]. In this project, we will witness this property through the deployment of a disease recognition model.
blocks.zh: 最近,NER的任务已经扩大,包括金额、百分比、日期、时间等。 最重要的是,由于蛋白质,DNA,RNA,细胞线,疾病,药物,生物体,突变的定制标签是实体类型[29],它被揭示为生物医学NLP的一项关键任务. 在这个项目中,我们将通过部署疾病识别模型来见证这一财产。

blocks.en: 3.1 Objectives
blocks.zh: 3.1 目标

blocks.en: There is an extrinsic evaluation objective at the core of this NER project, developing a full working pipeline able to localize the main entities in a real world global health publication. With that in mind, spaCy 14 14 14 https://spacy.io/ was selected as the reliable NLP framework offering fast industrial-strength information extraction trained pipelines.
blocks.zh: 这个NER项目的核心是外在评价目标,开发一个能够使主要实体在真实世界的全球卫生出版物中本地化的全工作管道。 考虑到这一点,SparCy 14 14 14 https://spacy.io/被选为可靠的NLP框架,提供快速的工业强度信息提取培训管道。

blocks.en: Ready to Deploy Pipeline:
blocks.zh: 准备部署管道 :

blocks.en: By the end of this project, my aim was to have a fully developed and functional back-end pipeline specialized in global health, ready for deployment in industrial envrionments and applications. Its primary goal being to provide a named entity recognition (NER) option that can be applied to user uploaded or existing publications. Furthermore, users should be able to run the NER process on their documents, allowing for the real-time localization and identification of key entities, which should be presented to the user upon completion. This would free human annotation time from global health experts, one of the main industry need factors, discussed in my motivation .
blocks.zh: 到该项目结束时,我的目标是使全球卫生领域的后端管道得到充分开发和功能化,并做好部署工业管道和应用的准备。 其主要目标是提供一个可适用于上载或现有出版物的用户的命名实体识别(NER)选项。 此外,用户应能够在自己的文件中运行NER进程,以便能够实时本地化和识别关键实体,完成后应提交用户。 这将让全球卫生专家腾出时间,

blocks.en: Considering the nature of our domain, additional requirements emerged. Given that low connectivity speeds and software size limitations remain significant challenges in digital global health, especially in LMICs 15 15 15 Low and Middle-Income Countries [ 31 ], the pipeline should prioritize speed and retain a reasonable model size, to emphasize accessibility.
blocks.zh: 考虑到我们领域的性质,出现了额外的要求。 鉴于低连通速度和软件尺寸限制仍然是全球数字卫生方面的重大挑战,特别是在15个15个低收入国家和中等收入国家[31],管道应优先考虑速度并保留合理的模型规模,以强调无障碍。

blocks.en: Evaluation of spaCy:

blocks.en: Having defined the practical importance and objectives of the project, the theoretical goal presented itself, in order to ensure optimal performance for both objectives. This involved conducting a formal evaluation of the selected framework and its pre-trained NER models, specifically assessing their adaptability to our domain-specific task. Concretely, a formal comparison of the model’s state of the art architectures, their fine-tuning capability, and their ability to adapt to new custom biomedical labels. At the end of this evaluation, one should have a better theoretical understanding of named entity recognition models and frameworks.
blocks.zh: 在确定了项目的实际重要性和目标之后,提出了理论目标,以确保这两个目标取得最佳业绩。 这包括对选定的框架及其经过预先培训的NER模型进行正式评估,具体评估其适应我们具体领域任务的适应性。 具体来说,正式比较模型的艺术建筑现状,其微调能力,以及适应新的定制生物医学标签的能力. 在本次评价结束时,人们应当从理论上更好地了解被命名的实体识别模式和框架。

blocks.en: 3.2.1 The Two Architectures

blocks.en: Our comparison will include four pre-trained spaCy models that are specialized in English. This choice was made knowing that the majority of global health research is published in english, however this task can be adapted to any language, by merely selecting another model. All models are able to recognize our selection of entity types given that they are trained on news data. Specifically, the 300-dimensional GloVe [ 32 ] vectors of the models are trained from Ontonotes 5.0 [ 33 ] as a large annotated corpus containing broadcast and newswires, Wordnet 3.0 [ 34 ] as a popular large lexical database of english, and Common Crawl as an additional supplier of web crawl data. This enormous amount of train data was another reason to utilize the knowledge of these pre-trained models, rather than training one from scratch.
blocks.zh: 我们的比较将包括四个预训疗养院 专攻英语的Cy模型. 之所以作出这种选择,是因为知道大多数全球卫生研究是用英文出版的,但这项任务只能通过选择另一种模式来适应任何语言。 所有模型都能够识别我们选择的实体类型,因为他们接受了新闻数据方面的培训。 具体来说,这些模型的300维GloVe [32]载体是从Ontonotes 5.0 [33] 训练成包含广播和新闻线的大型注解体,Wordnet 3.0 [34] 作为流行的英语大词典数据库,以及Common Crawl作为网络爬行数据的额外提供者. 如此大量的火车数据是利用这些预先训练过的模型知识的另一个原因,而不是从零开始训练。

blocks.en: From observation, one can understand that V V directly affects the model size in the case of the CNN ones. A small vocabulary gives us the ability to obtain compact models of a very low size, allowing us to analyze isolated real world cases where disk space is a constraint. On the other hand, vocabulary size is null for the transformer model given that it doesn’t rely on traditional word embedding vectors. Instead, the architecture leverages contextualized embeddings that capture the meaning of words based on the context of other surrounding words, such as in BERT [ 35 ]. This method of learning embeddings is a heavily parallelized process, henceforth GPU is recommended as the device to optimally run them.

blocks.en: Transformer-Based
blocks.zh: 基于变形器

blocks.en: As mentioned above, the en_core_web_trf model differs from the rest of the models by relying on learning contextualized embeddings based on the encoder part of the transformer architecture rather than utilizing word embeddings such as word2vec. Entirely dispensed of recurrence and convolutions, it only uses the attention mechanism to dynamically weigh the contextual importance of each word in a sentence [ 38 ].
blocks.zh: 如上所述,en_core_web_trf模型与其他模型不同,依靠基于变压器架构的编码器部分的学习上下文化嵌入,而不是使用单词嵌入,如word2vec. 它完全不重复和演化,只利用注意机制在句子中动态地权衡每个词的上下文重要性[38].

blocks.en: The attention mechanism’s superior performance in understanding relationships and dependencies between words revolutionized the NLP field, nevertheless accompanied by a higher computational cost in comparison to CNNs.
blocks.zh: 关注机制在理解单词之间的关系和依赖性方面的优异表现使NLP领域发生了革命性的变化,然而,与CNN相比,随之而来的计算成本更高。

blocks.en: Original Transformer’s Encoder Part - Attention Is All You Need [ 38 ]
blocks.zh: 原变形器编码器部分 - 注意是所有你需要的 [38]

blocks.en: Specifically, spaCy’s model is based on the base version of RoBERTa [ 39 ], a variant of the BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers) [ 35 ] model. This variant simply enhanced BERT’s performance through a longer training process with optimized hyperparameters, achieving better results on various natural language processing tasks [ 39 ]. Therefore, as in BERT, our model is equipped with the ability to generate word representations that are influenced by the context of both preceding and succeeding words, thus bidirectional.
blocks.zh: 特别是温泉 Cy的模型基于基版RoBERTa[39],BERT(变形器的双向编码器表示)[35]模型的一个变体. 这个变体只是通过一个使用优化超参数的较长的培训过程,提高了BERT的性能,在各种自然语言处理任务上取得了更好的效果[39]. 因此,与BERT一样,我们的模型具有生成受前言和后言背景影响的字词表达能力,从而具有双向性.

blocks.en: Having provided a brief introduction to the two architectures, let us highlight another property that all models incorporate into their NER pipeline, which is their dependency parsing capability when performing named entity recognition.
blocks.zh: 在简要介绍了这两个结构之后,让我们强调所有模型都纳入其NER管道的另一个财产,即它们在进行指定实体识别时的依赖性分析能力。

blocks.en: Dependency Parsing in NER
blocks.zh: NER 中的依赖性分析

blocks.en: In most languages, syntactic dependencies exist between groups of two or more words in a sentence. This relation is usually held between a syntactically subordinate word, called the dependent , and another word called the head [ 40 ]. For example, the noun news is a dependent of the verb had with the dependency type subject(SBJ) [ 40 ].
blocks.zh: 在大多数语言中,一个句子中两个或两个以上词组之间存在协同依赖. 这种关系通常在一个从策略上从属的单词,称为依附词,另一个单词称为头[40]之间保持. 例如,名词新闻是动词与依赖类型主题(SBJ)[40]的依赖.

blocks.en:
In relation to NER, the incorporation of a dependency parsing tree leads to a better performance in the recognition of nested entities [ 41 ].
A nested entity is a named entity that contains references to other named entities (e.g. Canton of Geneva), as opposed to a single flat entity (e.g. Geneva).
blocks.zh:
在NER方面,纳入一个依赖性剖析树会导致在认可巢实体方面表现更好[41].
巢实体是指包含提及其他命名实体(如日内瓦州)的命名实体,而不是单一的平面实体(如日内瓦).

blocks.en: Dependency Parsing Example in a Nested Entity
blocks.zh: 巢穴实体中的依赖性分析示例

blocks.en: Given that the majority of early NER research was focused on the recognition of flat entities while most real-life entities tend to be of a nested nature, the inclusion of automatic dependency parsing systems improved NER results across all models [ 41 ]. These systems predict a head for each token, in order to automatically assign head ↦ \mapsto dependent relations, based on a general grammatical knowledge of the language. Formally, given a Sentence S = { w 1 , w 2 , … , w i } S=\{w_{1},w_{2},...,w_{i}\} , a dependency arc is the set A = { ( h i , r i , d i ) } A=\{(h_{i},r_{i},d_{i})\} with h i h_{i} being the head word, r i r_{i} the syntactic relationship, and d i d_{i} the dependent word.
blocks.zh: 鉴于早期NER研究大多侧重于对扁平实体的承认,而大多数现实实体往往具有巢穴性质,因此,纳入自动依赖分析系统提高了所有模型的NER结果[41]. 这些系统为每个符号预测一个头,以便根据语言的一般语法知识自动指定头 \\\ mapsto 依赖关系. 形式上,给出的句子S={w 1,w 2,...,wi} S=\{w_{1},w_{2},...,w_{i}\},一个依赖弧是设定 A = { (h i, r i, d i )} {\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}我... 以 h i h_{i}为头词, r i r_{i} 共性关系, d i d_{i} 依赖词 。

blocks.en: Intuitively, the fact that words in a nested entity tend to follow a pattern in terms of their usual syntactic relationships, stands at the core of the improvement in performance. In particular, the spaCy models incorporate a non-monotonic transition system for dependency parsing, one that permits parsers to fix their previous parsing mistakes on the fly, to result in larger accurate parsing trees [ 42 ].
blocks.zh: 直觉上,一个巢穴实体中的文字在通常的合成关系上往往遵循一个规律,这一事实是表现改善的核心. 特别是温泉 Cy模型为依赖解析加入了一种非模拟的过渡系统,一种允许解析器在苍蝇上修正之前的解析错误,从而产生更大的精确解析树[42].

blocks.en: Sequence labeling evaluation is performed using seqeval 18 18 18 https://github.com/chakki-works/seqeval as the Python framework specialized for it. Respective lists of true values and predictions on a token level following the IOB schema will be passed as input to produce a classification score. Inside-Outside-Beginning (IOB) is a widely popular tagging schema for NER that offers a simple yet effective to accurately compute the score of a model over entity spans. Specifically, it improves readability its the three-label structure of marking each token as the beginning with an entity with B- , the ensuing tokens within the entity with I- and any other word token that is not an entity with O .

blocks.en: There are two principal remarks to make after observing the performance of these default pre-trained models. Firstly, the increase in model size is followed by an increase in performance, albeit not notable. All CNN models demonstrate an impressive speed by being able to process a single sentence in ≈ 5 \approx 5 milliseconds ( m ​ s ms ). Specifically, the medium CNN model en_core_web_md is distinguished, considering its performance despite the small size. Regarding the transformer model, its contextual embeddings capabilities lead to a bump in performance, as per expectation. Having said that, their 11 ​ x 11x slower processing time led to a decision to only proceed with the medium and large CNN models, hoping to increase their satisfactory default 0.69 \penalty\ 0.69 performance score through fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 在观察这些默认预训模型的性能后,有两点主要意见. 首先,在模型规模扩大之后,业绩也有所增加,尽管并不明显。 所有CNN的模型都表现出令人印象深刻的速度,能够用QQ 5\约5毫秒(m s ms)处理单个句子. 具体来说,考虑到其性能,尽管体积不大,但有中度CNN模式en_core_web_md被区分. 关于变压器模型,其内嵌能力按预期导致性能暴跌。 尽管如此,他们的11×11x慢化的处理时间导致决定只继续使用中大型CNN模型,希望增加他们满意的默认值0.69\Penalty\ 0.69通过微调成绩得分.

blocks.en: We can observe the competent performance of all the models with regard to our most important entity labels: persons, organizations, and geopolitical entities. Nevertheless, the average score is negatively affected by the poor performance in the recognition of laws and products, except for the transformer models which utilize their contextual understanding to achieve a better recognition. This is due to the low number of instances in addition to the complex nature of both entity types, given that laws may present themselves in different formats as well as the PRODUCT label not being clear if it’s related to names of digital health marketable products. Having said that, it ultimately displays a need for fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 我们可以观察到在我们最重要的实体标签方面,即个人、组织和地缘政治实体方面,所有模式的称职表现。 然而,平均得分受到法律和产品识别表现不佳的不利影响,但变压器模型除外,变压器模型利用它们的背景理解来获得更好的识别。 这是因为,除了两类实体性质复杂之外,案例数量较少,因为法律可能以不同的形式出现,而且产品销售标签不清楚是否与数字保健产品的名称有关。 尽管如此,这最终表明有必要进行微调。

blocks.zh: 在介绍这些例子之后,人们可以理解需要调整我们的模型需要,以便更好地处理全球卫生出版物中的句子。

blocks.en: 3.3 Fine-Tuning a model
blocks.zh: 3.3 精制型号

blocks.en: Fine-tuning is the process of taking the representations from our pretrained models, and further training them to be better adapted to the downstream task of named entity recognition to our labeled dataset. Typically, this training will make only minimal adjustments to the pretrained language model parameters [ 44 ].
blocks.zh: 精细调整是从我们经过预先训练的模型中提取表述,进一步培训这些模型,使其更好地适应命名实体对我们标注的数据集的下游任务. 通常,这种培训只会对预先训练的语言模型参数进行最小的调整[44].

blocks.en: This concept stands as one of the capabilities of spaCy models. They have the possibility to adjust their word vectors through supervised further-training on a given dataset. In our case, the presumed result will be a fine-tuned named entity recognition process, finely tuned to align more accurately with the entities annotated in our training dataset.
blocks.zh: 这一概念是水疗能力之一 模特儿们 它们有可能通过对特定数据集进行有监督的进一步培训来调整其文字矢量。 就我们而言,假定的结果将是经过微调的指定实体确认程序,经过微调,与我们培训数据集中附加说明的实体更加一致。

blocks.en: A mock example to demonstrate this property is a comparision between a default CNN model and a fine-tuned one fed with multiple sentences that included GDPR (LAW) and United States (GPE) entities, the results of which are displayed below:
blocks.zh: 一个典型的证明这种属性的例子是,默认的CNN模式与包含GDPR(LAW)和美国(GPE)实体的多句子的微调模式之间的比较,其结果如下:

blocks.en: Fine-Tuning Results Example
blocks.zh: 微调结果示例

blocks.en: As we can observe, the model learned to recognize GDPR as a law entity type, in addition to recognizing the geopolitical nested entity without the inclusion of the determinant.
blocks.zh: 正如我们所观察到的,该模型学会了承认GDPR为法律实体类型,此外还承认地缘政治嵌套实体而不包括决定因素。

blocks.en: One of the most important problems to keep in mind when performing fine-tuning is the ’ catastrophic forgetting ’ phenomenon. It refers to the tendency that pretrained models have to forget previously learned representations when they are presented with new data during fine-tuning and is especially lethal when the fine-tuning dataset is relatively small, such as in our case. A carefully curated annotated dataset in addition to an optimized selection of hyper-parameters is crucial to combat this phenomenon.
blocks.zh: 在进行微调时需要记住的最重要问题之一是`灾难性的忘记 ' 现象。 它指的是一种趋势,即预先训练过的模型在微调时得到新数据时必须忘记以前学到的表示,而当微调数据集相对较小时,例如我们的情况,则特别致命。 除了优化选择超参数外,精心整理附加说明的数据集对于打击这一现象至关重要。

blocks.en: 3.3.1 Data Annotation with Prodigy
blocks.zh: 3.3.1 国家 带有Prodigy的数据注释

blocks.en: The majority of traditional natural language processing tasks such as named entity recognition are not routine tasks, and therefore rely on supervised learning through an annotated corpus. To this day, human annotation still stands as one of the slowest and expensive tasks of supervised learning projects [ 45 ].
blocks.zh: 大多数传统的自然语言处理任务,如命名的实体识别,都不是例行的任务,因此依赖于通过附加说明的教程进行监督学习. 时至今日,人类的注释仍然是监督学习项目中最缓慢,最昂贵的任务之一[45].

blocks.en: Hence why data annotation tools that facilitate the process have been indispensable in the industry and research. One such example is Prodigy 21 21 21 https://prodi.gy/ , a tool developed by the spaCy team designed to streamline the data creation process in the field of natural language processing. Taking as input a set of raw sentences, it provides a user-friendly web interface where you can annotate each token to its corresponding named entity label by simply clicking on it. The result is a fully annotated dataset that is formatted according to the expectations of the models during training, making fine-tuning seamless.
blocks.zh: 因此,为什么促进这一进程的数据注释工具在工业和研究中是必不可少的。 其中一个例子是Prodigy 21 21 21 https://prodi.gy/,这是一个由温泉开发的工具。 Cy团队旨在简化自然语言处理领域的数据创建过程. 它以一组原始句子作为输入,提供了一个方便用户的网页界面,您可以通过简单的点击,将每个令牌标注到相应的命名实体标签上. 结果是根据模型在培训期间的期望格式化的全注解数据集,使微调无缝.

blocks.en: Another key property of Prodigy related to active learning during annotation, is its ability to provide real-time predictions from the pretrained models. This helps the annotator debug the model’s error in the case of misaligned predictions, in addition to accelerating the whole process in the case of correct predictions.
blocks.zh: 普罗迪基的另一个关键属性与注解期间的主动学习有关,是其从预训模型中提供实时预测的能力. 这有助于注释者调试模型在错误的预测情况下的错误,此外在正确预测的情况下加速整个过程.

blocks.en: Prodigy - Active Learning
blocks.zh: 天才 - 积极学习

blocks.en: Above is displayed an example where the model suggested a correct entity prediction while also providing a false positive (Nvidia as a Geopolitical Entity), needing to be fixed.
blocks.zh: 上面举出一个例子,说明模型提出正确的实体预测,同时提供假阳性(Nvidia作为一个地缘政治实体),需要固定。

blocks.en: The evaluation set on which the default models were compared was created in this manner. We can observe the dominance of organization entity types, and that reflects the reality given that these sentences were extracted from actual publications ( 100 Publications Corpus ).
blocks.zh: 用来比较默认模型的评价集就是以这种方式创建的. 我们可以看到组织实体类型的主导地位,这反映了实际情况,因为这些句子是从实际出版物(100 Publications Corpus)中摘取的。

blocks.en: The correct full prediction of lengthy nested entities that usually represent a law or organization entity type, is one of the challenges presented by this dataset.
blocks.zh: 对通常代表一种定律或组织实体类型的长期嵌套实体的正确全面预测,是本数据集提出的挑战之一.

blocks.en: One can notice that the context of the sentence is almost always related to the global digital health domain. In the case of geopolitical entity (GPE) recognition, models tended to be fairly accurate knowing that names of countries are not changing anytime soon. Therefore, the annotation focus shifted towards fine-tuning the models to recognize more vast entities such as: continents, regions, LMICs, HICs, and more, to the GPE label.
blocks.zh: 人们可以注意到,句子的背景几乎总是与全球数字健康领域有关. 就地缘政治实体(GPE)的承认而言,模式往往相当准确,因为知道国家名称不会很快改变。 因此,注解的重点转向对模型进行微调,以识别更广阔的实体,例如:大陆、区域、LMICs、HICs,以及更多的GPE标签。

blocks.en: Other challenging to predict instances were created through sentences that contain more named entities than other words, or even sentences that are composed solely of named entities. Inclusion of multiple entities of different labels in a single sentence is important in order to provide a balanced distribution while the inclusion of common easy-to-recognize entities combats the catastrophic forgetting problem.
blocks.zh: 其他难以预测的事件是通过包含比其他单词更多的名称实体的句子,甚至只是由名称实体组成的句子来创建的. 将不同标签的多个实体纳入一个单句很重要,以便提供均衡的分布,同时将容易识别的普通实体纳入其中将解决灾难性的遗忘问题。

blocks.en: Inclusion of professional titles to the PERSON nested entity was another priority of this fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 将职业头衔列入 " 个人 " 嵌套实体是这一微调的另一个优先事项。

blocks.en: Adversarial examples are passed as sentences that do not contain any entity. Apart from being significantly challenging to predict without having the proper context, these types of sentences also fine-tune the model. Specifically, training it to disregard any word included in them in relation to NER.
blocks.zh: 反常的例子作为不含任何实体的句子而出现. 这些类型的句子除了在缺乏适当背景的情况下对预测具有很大挑战性外,还对模型进行了微调. 具体地说,训练它忽略其中任何与NER有关的词语。

blocks.en:
To conclude it, the annotations were produced with the goal of challenging NER models while also fine-tuning them to our specific task. While some ground truth labels are definitive, other annotations are subjective and depend on the intuition of annotators (e.g. tagging LMICs as GPE). Such cases were consulted with my supervisor and other global health experts, before arriving to the final annotation. Annotation protocols should satisfy several criteria: expressive enough to capture the phenomenon of interest, ability to be replicable meaning that other annotators would produce a very similar annotation, and the ability to be scalable , meaning they can be produced relatively fast [ 46 ].
I made every effort to create this dataset while staying faithful to these protocols.
blocks.zh:
最后,编写说明的目的是对NER模型提出挑战,同时根据我们的具体任务对其进行微调。 虽然一些地面真理标签是确定的,但其他说明是主观的,并取决于注释者的直觉(例如标记LMICs为GPE). 在作出最后说明之前,已同我的主管和其他全球卫生专家协商过这些案件。 注释协议应满足若干标准:表达性足以捕捉兴趣现象,具有可复制性的能力意味着其他注释者会产生非常相似的注释,具有可扩展性的能力,意味着它们可以相对快速地产生[46].
我尽力创建了这个数据集 同时忠于这些协议

blocks.en: 3.3.2 Training
After the dataset was created, a 70% Train / 30% Test split was performed, in order to proceed with the fine-tuning.
blocks.zh: 数据集创建后,进行了70%的列车/30%的试制拆分,以继续微调.

blocks.en: In spaCy, fine-tuning is carried through the command line, where the default model, train data, and a configuration file of training hyperparameters are passed as input. After the results of our model evaluation chapter, it was decided to move forward with only the medium and large versions of the CNN models: en_core_web_md and en_core_web_lg . The transformer model was abandoned for our document processing task due to the slower processing times (11x slower than CNNs), in addition to the high computational complexity it requires in order to be fine-tuned.
blocks.zh: 在spaCy中,微调通过命令行进行,其中默认模型,列车数据,以及训练超参数的配置文件作为输入传递. 在我们的模型评价章节结果出来后,决定只推进CNN模型的中大版本:en_core_web_md和en_core_web_lg. 由于处理时间较慢(11x比CNN慢),除了为了微调需要高的计算复杂度外,变压器模型也因我们的文件处理任务而被放弃.

blocks.en: Therefore, the [ tok2vec, ner ] pipelines of both models would be fine-tuned as according to the configuration file. The tokenizer, convolutional neural network, and dependency parsing architectures remained unchanged from the default ones, after experimenting.
blocks.zh: 因此,两种型号的[tok2vec,ner]管线将按照配置文件进行微调. 标致器 进化神经网络 依赖解析结构 与默认的一样 实验后保持不变

blocks.en: Apart from that, our hyperparameters related to the training in itself were: number of epochs e = 100 e=100 , batch size b = 200 b=200 to boost computational efficiency, dropout p D = 0.1 p_{D}=0.1 and L2 Norm = 0.01 0.01 for regularization, and Adam V1 with a learning rate of η = 0.01 \eta=0.01 as one of the most efficient optimizers in stochastic gradient descent problems [ 47 ].
blocks.zh: 除此之外,我们与培训本身有关的超参数是:e=100 e=100;b=200 b=200以提高计算效率;pD=0.1 p_{D}=0.1和L2 Norm=0.01正规化;Adam V1的学习率为 η = 0.01\eta=0.01,是时间跨度下降问题中最有效的优化者之一[47]。

blocks.en: ’spacy train’ - Fine-Tuning Command Line
blocks.zh: " 温和的火车 " - 精通指挥线

blocks.en: After multiple runs with different configurations, the one displayed above resulting in ≈ 0.80 \approx 0.80 average score was the most stable. The score is computed using it’s strict version, which requires index-perfect entity prediction to count it as accurate. Therefore, the fine-tuning seemed promising knowing that the prior default model evaluation was computed through the more lenient scoring function.
blocks.zh: 经过多个配置不同的运行后,上面显示的导致QQ 0.80\约0.80平均分的运行是最稳定的. 得分使用严格的版本计算,这需要指数完善的实体预测来计算准确性。 因此,微调似乎很有希望,知道先前的默认模式评价是通过较宽松的评分函数计算的。

blocks.en: 3.3.3 Conclusion

Upon concluding the training, the more lenient scoring function was performed in order to obtain a classification score as to the prior evaluation. As during the interim score shown during training, the improvement in comparison to the default models was noticeable. Given that fine-tuning merely adjusts the original vectors without modifying their size, the processing speed per-sentence was still decent.
blocks.zh: 在完成培训后,为了获得与前一次评价相比的分类分数,所履行的评分职能更为宽松。 与培训期间显示的临时分数一样,与缺省模式相比,情况明显改善。 鉴于微调只是调整原始矢量而不改变其大小,处理速度每句仍然相当.

blocks.en: Performance Distribution per Entity Label - After Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 每个实体标签的性能分布 - 精细调整后

blocks.en: The level of improvement in terms of performance for the fine-tuned model is easily distinguishable. For the majority of the labels, this is the result of the better adaptation to recognizing nested named entities as we intended during annotation. In addition to that, the recognition of new entities based on our labeling that the pre-trained models were previously unable to identify (e.g. LMICs, HICs, and Continents as GPE), enhanced the performance further.
blocks.zh: 微调模型在性能上的改进程度很容易区分. 对于大多数的标签来说,这是更好地适应在注释中如我们所希望的那样识别巢命名实体的结果。 此外,根据我们的标签,即事先训练过的模型以前无法识别(例如LMICs、HICs和Continents为GPE),对新实体的承认进一步提高了业绩。

blocks.en: Regarding the LAW label, fine-tuning with clear instances of laws that follow a certain format (in our case mostly American or Swiss Laws, written as "The Act of Something") resulted in a bump in performance regarding their recognition. Having said that, this is not expected to generalize well with the diverse range of laws worldwide, knowing that each legislative power institution writes laws in their own unique way.
blocks.zh: 关于《法律》的标签,对遵循某种格式的法律(主要为美国法律或瑞士法律,写成“某事法案”)的明确实例进行微调,导致在承认法律方面出现失误。 话虽如此,但预计这不会很好地概括世界各地各种法律,因为知道每个立法权力机构都以自己独特的方式写法律。

blocks.en: Therefore, the cases where the difference in performance between the default and fine-tuned models is significant should still be viewed with caution. The limited size of the training set in addition to a high number of epochs might be a sign of overfitting, meaning that the model does not generalize well on unseen data.
blocks.zh: 因此,对于缺省模式和微调模式之间业绩差异很大的情况,仍应谨慎对待。 除了大量的时代之外,培训集的有限规模可能表明过于吻合,这意味着该模式在无形数据上没有很好地概括。

blocks.en: After further benchmarking, it was found that recognition of LAWs still generalizes well while the PRODUCT label remains the least stable. This is due to the fact that the original model wasn’t trained with global health products in mind, hence it was dropped as a label moving forward.
blocks.zh: 在进一步制定基准之后,人们发现,对法律的承认仍然十分普遍,而产品标签仍然是最不稳定的。 之所以如此, 是因为最初的模型没有经过全球卫生产品的训练,

blocks.en: 3.4 Custom Label Training - Disease Recognition
blocks.zh: 3.4 定制标签培训----疾病识别

blocks.en: One of the advantages of using spaCy’s pipelines for named entity recognition is their customizability, the fact that you are not limited to solely using the pretrained models. You are also able to train a blank NER model from scratch with your own training examples, adapting it to custom entity types of one’s application requirements [ 48 ]. Essentially, as long as one has a trusted annotated dataset at disposal, one can train a NER model able to recognize any custom label entity out of it.
blocks.zh: 使用温泉的优点之一 Cy的指定实体识别管道是其可定制性,即你并不仅限于使用预先训练过的模型。 您也可以从零开始用自己的训练实例来训练空白的 NER 模型,使其适应个人应用要求的自定义实体类型 [48] 。 基本上,只要有一个值得信赖的附加说明的数据集可供使用,就可以训练一个NER模型,能够识别出任何自定义的标签实体.

blocks.en: For the most part, one rarely trains a blank model from scratch as pretrained models are preferred for general named entity recognition tasks given their performance and reliability. Another constraint is the scarceness of available annotated NER data released for the public. However, when trusted data is available and the required entity type for the application is one of a unique nature, custom training is necessary.
blocks.zh: 在大多数情况下,人们很少从零开始训练一个空白模型,因为鉴于其性能和可靠性,对一般命名的实体识别任务来说,预先训练的模型更受青睐。 另一个限制因素是向公众发布的附加说明的NER数据很少。 然而,当可以获得可靠数据,且应用程序所需的实体类型具有独特性时,需要自定义培训。

blocks.en: Such was our case, where a DISEASE label was required in order to extract the main types of diseases mentioned in a global health publication.
blocks.zh: 我们的情况就是如此,为了提取全球卫生出版物中提到的主要疾病类型,需要给疾病分类贴上标签。

blocks.en: 3.4.1 NCBI Disease Corpus
blocks.zh: 3.4.1 国家儿童局 疾病体格

blocks.en: Our chosen dataset is the public release of the NCBI Disease Corpus , a corpus which contains a total of 6892 disease mentions, mapped to 790 unique disease concepts [ 49 ]. Out of these, 88 % 88\% are linked to a Medical Subject Heading (MeSh) identifier, while the rest to a Online Mendelian Inheritance in Man (OMIM) one [ 49 ].
blocks.zh: 我们所选择的数据集是公开发布NCBI疾病科普(CBI Corpus), 包含总共6892种疾病, 其中,有88%的88\%与医学主题头目(MeSh)识别符相连,其余则与在线孟德兰人继承人(OMIM)1[49]有关.

blocks.en: The annotation process of this corpus enhances its credibility by involving 14 biomedical experts as annotators, paired randomly to avoid bias, in order to go through three phases of annotation by following certain guidelines [ 49 ]. Knowing the complex nature of disease names due to their variation and ambiguity, in addition to the numerous unique instances, choosing a community-trusted dataset such as this one emerged as the most favourable option.
blocks.zh: 通过让14名生物医学专家作为注解员,随机配对以避免偏见,通过遵循某些准则,经过三个阶段的注解过程,本文书的注解过程提高了其可信度。 了解疾病名称因其变化和模糊性而具有复杂性质,除了许多独特的情况外,选择一个社区信任的数据集,如这个数据集,成为最有利的选择。

blocks.en: In addition to that, another reason for choosing this corpus is that is already pre-split into a train, validation, and evaluation set, from its publication. This makes it ready to be integrated into the training process and eliminates any possibility that a random split from my side might not be optimal.
blocks.zh: 除此以外,选择这一文书的另一个原因是,它已经预先分解成火车、鉴定和评价的一套,从它出版开始。 这使得它准备融入培训进程,并消除了任意从我一方分裂可能不理想的任何可能性。

blocks.en: 3.4.2 Performance

The dataset was downloaded from its instance stored in HuggingFace 22 22 22 https://huggingface.co/datasets/ncbi_disease , a leading platform of natural language processing datasets and models. It contains 5433 train ( 74 % 74\% ) instances, 924 validation ( 13 % 13\% ), and 941 test ( 13 % 13\% ) ones. Each instance is a tokenized sentence encoded as an array of tags, where 0 indicates no disease mentioned, 1 signals the first token of a disease and 2 the subsequent disease tokens.
blocks.zh: 该数据集从其存储在HuggingFace 22 22 22 https://huggingface.co/datasets/ncbi_disease中的实例下载,这是自然语言处理数据集和模型的主要平台. 它包含5433辆列车(74%为74\%),924辆验证车(13%为13\%),941辆试验车(13%为13\%). 每个实例都是一个符号化的句子,编码成一系列标记,其中0表示没有提及疾病,1表示疾病的第一个标志,2表示随后的疾病标志.

blocks.en: The next step to adapt the data into spaCy training pipeline was converting it from the default tag array format to Doc objects. This allows the training to start, one which will convert a blank model with an empty pipeline to a disease recognition one, by adapting its pretrained word vectors to our task. The training configuration file was kept identical to the one used to fine-tune the CNNs, given that its hyperparameters were established as most optimal.
blocks.zh: 下一步将数据调整为温泉 Cy 训练管道正在将其从默认的标记数组格式转换为 Doc 对象 。 这样就可以开始训练了,一个可以把空管的空白模型转换成疾病识别模型,通过调整其预先训练过的字向量来适应我们的任务. 训练配置文件与用于微调CNN的配置文件相同,因为其超参数被确定为最优化。

blocks.en: Disease Recognition - Model Training Disease Recognition - Test Set Evaluation 23 23 23 P: Precision, R: Recall, F: F-Score
blocks.zh: 疾病识别 - 示范培训疾病识别 - 测试集评价 23 23 P:精度、R:召回、F:F-分数

blocks.en: After 25 epochs, the training resulted in a ≈ 81 % \approx 81\% disease recognition CNN model, able to maintain the speed identified during the default model evaluation. Once again, this shows the customizability of spaCy’s pipeline and named entity recognition as a task in itself. As long as you have a reliable annotated dataset, you can tailor NER to suit any custom labels for a specific domain.
blocks.zh: 经过25个纪元后,训练产生了一个\\\ 大约81%\\\ 疾病识别的CNN模型,能够维持默认模型评价中识别的速度. 这再次显示了温泉的自定义性 Cy的管道和被命名的实体承认本身是一项任务. 只要有可靠的注解数据集,就可以裁剪NER来适应特定域的任何自定义标签.

blocks.en: 3.4.3 The Complete Model
blocks.zh: 3.4.3 国家 完整模式

blocks.zh: 在成功建立了稳定的疾病识别模式后,下一步是将其与其他微调模式整合,以创建我们最终优化的命名实体识别管道. 1 导入丝绸 2 3 ### 装入两个优化型号4 fine_tuned_model=spacy. load ("Disk-path-to-model") 5种疾病_model=spacy. load ("Disk-path-to-model") 6种疾病_model. 替换_ listeners ("tok2vec","ner",[model.tok2vec]) 7 8 +++ 添加疾病识别 微调整型号的输油管 9 fine_tune_tune_model. 添加_pipe (10"ner",11名="ner_dises",12源=疾病_model,"ner"后13") Python中的两个型号合并.

blocks.en: The disease recognition pipeline was integrated after the default NER pipeline of the fine-tuned model, meaning that the DISEASE label is the last one predicted. It is a decision made to avoid any confusion, knowing that the two models are trained on datasets of different natures.
blocks.zh: 疾病识别管道在微调模型的默认NER管道后被整合,这意味着DISEASE标签是最后一个预测的. 这是为避免任何混淆而作出的决定,因为知道这两个模型都受过不同性质数据集的培训。

blocks.en: Having said that, this merge established the full model able to annotate all intended entity types in a sentence. Although not perfect in terms of accuracy, it maintained the speed of the CNN architecture, making predictions in milliseconds per sentence.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,这一合并确立了一个完整的模式,能够在一句话中说明所有预定实体类型。 虽然在准确性方面并不完美,但它保持了CNN架构的速度,每句预测以毫秒计.

blocks.en: Following the model evaluation, fine-tuning to our entity annotations, and establishing disease recognition, we are equipped with a ready-to-use model that could start annotating entire documents. Therefore, apart from the theoretical evaluation, we were one step closer to building a pipeline with regard to the industry need.
blocks.zh: 遵循模型评估,细化实体说明,建立疾病识别体系,我们配备了即时使用模式,可以开始对全部文件进行注释. 因此,除了理论评估外,我们还朝着就工业需求建立管道迈出了一步。

blocks.en: 3.5 Document Processing Pipeline
blocks.zh: 3.5 文件处理管道

blocks.en: Revisiting our original objective regarding the industry need, our aim is to proceed a from a PDF file containing a global health publication into a final list of main entities it encompasses. This was developed with the goal of automatically populating a knowledge base when only given a list of publications.
blocks.zh: 重新审视我们关于行业需要的最初目标,我们的目标是从一个包含全球卫生出版物的PDF文档,到它包括的主要实体的最后清单。 这是为了在只提供出版物清单时自动提供知识库。

blocks.en: The application requires only two disk paths prerequisites: the one to the PDF file of the publication and the one of the final fine-tuned model. The entirety of the pipeline was developed as a Python script and was separated from the rest of the thesis code. This was a design choice made to think of it as a deployable application released on its own, or one that could be integrated into an already existing application that is in need of this task.
blocks.zh: 应用程序只需要两个磁盘路径的先决条件:一个是出版物的PDF文件,另一个是最终的微调模型. 整个管道是作为Python脚本开发的,并与论文的其余代码分离. 这是一种设计选择,认为它是自行释放的可部署应用程序,或可并入需要完成这项任务的现有应用程序。

blocks.en: 3.5.1 Text Extraction
blocks.zh: 3.5.1 提取案文

blocks.en: For the first part that requires the entirety of the text to be extracted from the PDF, two text extraction tools adapted for Python were used and compared, PyPDF2 and pdfminer . They extract text contents from the internal structure of a PDF, therefore were selected as a generally faster alternative than Optical Character Recognition (OCR) methods.
blocks.zh: 对于要求从PDF中提取全文的第一部分,使用了两个适合Python的文本提取工具,PyPDF2和pdfminer. 它们从PDF的内部结构中提取文字内容,因此被选为一般比光学字符识别(OCR)方法更快的替代品.

blocks.en: We were aiming for the most accurate extraction results, wanting the full extraction of the publication without any misses. This approach aimed to maximize the number of extracted entities while minimizing grammatical errors, thus avoiding creating any potential confusion for the model.
blocks.zh: 我们的目标是取得最准确的提取结果,希望完全提取该出版物而不遗漏。 这种方法旨在尽量扩大被提取实体的数量,同时尽量减少语法错误,从而避免给模型造成任何潜在的混淆.

blocks.en: After benchmarking on one of our corpora, pdfminer resulted in the more cleaner and accurate extraction of the information. Another positive remark was its capability to capture the text highlighted in complex elements such as tables, graphs, and other visually engaging content, therefore it was selected as the library.
blocks.zh: 在以我们公司之一作为基准之后, pdfminer使信息更清洁和准确。 另一项积极的意见是,它有能力捕捉在表格、图表和其他视觉内容等复杂要素中突出显示的案文,因此它被选为库。

blocks.en: 3.5.2 Text Pre-Processing
blocks.zh: 3.5.2 文本处理前

blocks.en: The results of the text extraction process are presented in a string format, meaning the entirety of the text found in a publication is stored in a single string. On the other hand, our NER model expects a list of sentences in order to predict entities in each sentence, therefore a pre-processing step of sentence tokenization is required.
blocks.zh: 文本提取过程的结果以字符串格式呈现,意思是出版物中发现的全部文本都存储在一个字符串中. 另一方面,我们的NER模型期望有一份句子列表,以便预测每个句子中的实体,因此需要一个预处理步骤的句子符号化.

blocks.en: Before the tokenization process, Python’s string.find(substring) method that finds the first occurrence of a certain substring was exploited for two simple yet important tasks for our project, finding and extracting keywords and references in the text of a publication.
blocks.zh: 在符号化过程之前,Python的字符串.find(substring)方法发现了某个子字符串的首次出现,它被用于我们项目的两个简单而重要的任务,在出版物文本中查找和提取关键词和引用.

blocks.en: Keywords of a publication contain a selection of words that best summarizes the topic of a document. They were chosen to be extracted to be compared with our final list of main extracted entities in terms of granularity.
blocks.zh: 出版物的关键词包含一些最能概括文件主题的词。 从颗粒性来看,它们被选作与我们最后的被采取的主要实体清单相比较。

blocks.en: References that are usually listed on the final pages of a publication contain types of entities such as names of people, organizations, universities, etc. Therefore the goal of their extraction was to delete them from the string as they would serve no purpose to the named entity recognition task. On the contrary, passing them through the NER pipeline creates confusion given that the entities located in the references would be counted in the final results.
blocks.zh: 通常在出版物最后页上列出的参考文献包含人物,组织,大学等实体名称的类型. 因此,提取它们的目的是从字符串中删除它们,因为它们对被命名的实体识别任务没有任何作用。 相反,通过NER管道传递它们会造成混乱,因为参考文献中的实体将计入最终结果。

blocks.en: Text Pre-Processing - Extracting Keywords & References
blocks.zh: 文本预处理 - 提取关键字和参考

blocks.en: As observed through the sample of results displayed above, both methods are capable of successfully extracting both envisioned sections of a publication. Considering the efficiency of all string manipulation methods, the extraction process is conducted in ≈ 2 ​ m ​ s \approx 2ms , hereby showing the motive to include this method in the document processing pipeline. Even in cases where neither references or keywords are extracted due to a nature of a publication of the failure of the finding method, the total runtime of the named entity recognition pipelined is hardly affected.
blocks.zh: 从上文显示的结果样本中可以看出,这两种方法都能够成功地提取所设想出版物的两个部分。 考虑到所有字符串操纵方法的效率,提取过程以 QQ 2 m s\ 大约 2 ms 进行,在此显示将这种方法纳入文件处理管道的动机. 即使在由于公布查找方法失败的性质而未提取任何参考文献或关键词的情况下,被命名的实体识别管道的总运行时间也几乎没有受到影响。

blocks.en: Tokenizer
blocks.zh: 切换器

blocks.en: Tokenizing the document text string into a list of sentences stands as the final part of the pre-processing step, the format expected by the fine-tuned NER model. After a comparison of tokenizer offered by the two popular NLP libraries, spaCy and nltk (Natural Language Toolkit) , nltk’s sentence tokenizer was selected as a faster and more reliable solution. A solution in the form of a pre-trained Punkt english tokenizer that uses an unsupervised algorithm to build a model for abbreviation words, collocations, and words that start sentences, trained on a large collection of plaintext 24 24 24 nltk - Punkt Sentence Tokenizer .
blocks.zh: 将文档文本字符串切入句子列表是预处理步骤的最后部分,即微调NER模型所期望的格式. 在比较了两个流行的NLP库(spanCy)和nltk(自然语言工具包)提供的标语器后,nltk的句子标语器被选为更快和更可靠的解决方案. 一种以预先训练的朋克特英语标语器为形式的解决方案,它使用一个不受监督的算法来构建一个缩写词的模型,集合,以及开始句子的单词,在大量收集的Plaintext 24 24 nltk - Punkt Pried Tokenizer上训练.

blocks.en: A collection of lists, each containing a sentence of the document, is fed into the full fine-tuned named entity recognition model, where predictions are made consecutively. Apart from the fact that the majority of NLP libraries expect a sentence-level input, this segmentation of the text into sentences rather than passing it as a single large string allows for a better contextual accuracy and facilitates error analysis as it is easier to pinpoint inaccurate predictions.
blocks.zh: 一组清单,每个清单中包含文件的句子,被输入经过全面微调的命名实体识别模型中,在那里连续进行预测. 除了大多数NLP库都期望有句级输入外,这种将文本分割成句子而不是作为单一的大字符串传递,可以提高上下文的准确性,方便错误分析,因为更容易确定不准确的预测.

blocks.en: 3.5.3 NER: Filtering All Predictions
blocks.zh: 3.5.3 NER: 过滤所有预测

blocks.en: This sub-chapter will provide a brief explanation of the screening that all entity predictions go through in order to obtain a final refined set of named entities that better portray a global health publication.
blocks.zh: 本分节将简要说明所有实体预测的筛选情况,以便获得一套最终的精细命名实体,更好地描绘全球卫生出版物。

blocks.en: All predicted entities are stored in a dictionary that contains each unique entity found in a publication as a key, ensuring a consistent set of references. The values associated with each unique key represent the number of occurrences said entity was found in the publication, acting as a total count. This data structure was chosen as the most versatile, allowing an efficient retrieval and manipulation of the data.
blocks.zh: 所有预测的实体都存储在一本词典中,其中包含在出版物中发现的每一个独特的实体作为关键,确保一组一致的参考文献. 与每个独特的密钥有关的数值代表出版物中所说的实体发生次数,作为总数。 这一数据结构被选为最具多功能性的数据,从而能够有效地检索和管理数据。

blocks.en: This selection of entity candidates was made with the simple verity in mind that the main named entities of a publication are those that occur the most through its text. Henceforth, the next step in the algorithm sorts the dictionaries by the highest count, to narrow down the number of named entities based on their occurrences in relation to the highest occurrence.
blocks.zh: 挑选实体候选人时所考虑的很简单,出版物的主要命名实体是其文本中最突出的实体。 从此以后,算法中的下一步是用最高的计数来排序词典,以根据其发生数相对于最高发生数缩小命名实体的数目.

blocks.en: With regard to each entity label, main entities are selected based on a threshold on their count in relation to the highest count, a threshold acting as a noise reduction mechanism. Knowing that entities that appear more frequently in a document will most likely be key organizations, countries, and persons that hold more significance in the text. After benchmarking on a set of different documents, the main threshold chosen was 1 3 \frac{1}{3} , meaning that succeeding entities with a count not less than 1 3 \frac{1}{3} of the highest count will be selected as main entity candidates. This approach aims to find a balance between simplicity and comprehensiveness, balancing the simplicity of choosing only the entity of the highest occurrence and the complexity of including every single rare correct predicted entity.
blocks.zh: 关于每个实体的标签,主要实体是根据与最高点相比的计数阈值来选择的,这一阈值起到降噪机制的作用. 了解文件更经常出现的实体很可能是重要组织、国家和在案文中具有更大意义的人。 在对一组不同的文件设定基准之后,所选择的主要阈值是1 3\frac{1\3},这意味着计数不少于1 3\frac{1\3}的继任实体将被选为主要实体候选人. 这种办法的目的是在简单性和全面性之间找到一种平衡,平衡仅仅选择发生次数最多的实体的简单性和包括每一个罕见的正确预测实体的复杂性。

blocks.en: The figure above displays a sample of the threshold-based filtering for the following publication: The increase in child obesity in Switzerland is mainly due to migration from Southern Europe – a cross-sectional study 25 25 25 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33514341/ , one of the publications that acted as a point of reference during benchmarking. Considering the content of the said publication, the entirety of extracted main entities represent central named entities to the content’s narrative.
blocks.zh: 上图为以下出版物展示了基于阈值的过滤样本: 1. 瑞士儿童肥胖症增加的主要原因是从南欧移民——一项跨部门研究25 25 25 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33514341/,这是基准制定期间作为参照点的出版物之一。 考虑到上述出版物的内容,该出版物的叙述部分中,所有摘取的主要实体都代表了中央名称的实体。

blocks.en: Once again, this strategy of extracting entities based on their frequency ensures a final entity collection that represents the publication’s central themes. In addition to the interpretability, the computational efficiency of this approach needs to be mentioned as yet another benefit. Knowing that the extraction only leverages the distribution of entities rather than involving complex algorithms or extensive processing, computational efficiency is ensured.
blocks.zh: 这种根据实体的频率提取实体的战略再次确保了代表该出版物中心主题的最后实体收藏。 除了可解释性外,还需要提到这种方法的计算效率是另一个好处。 了解提取只会影响实体的分布,而不是涉及复杂的算法或广泛的处理,就可以确保计算效率.

blocks.en: Example - Final Named Entities
blocks.zh: 示例 - 最后命名的实体

blocks.en: Apart from the threshold-based method, additional filtering methods that utilized the Levenshtein string similarity metric were applied, with the goal of providing a further refined final selection of extracted named entities. Specifically, methods that detect and eliminate similar words that hold the same meaning and a special method for disease entities that include sub-categories of a primary disease entity in the final list, irrespective of their frequency. ( Child Obesity ↦ \mapsto Obesity )
blocks.zh: 除了基于阈值的方法外,还采用了使用Levenshtein字符串相似度测量法的其他过滤方法,目的是对提取的指定实体进行进一步的精细的最后选择。 具体来说,检测并消除具有相同含义的类似词的方法,以及对将初级疾病实体的子类列入最终清单的疾病实体的一种特殊方法,而不论其频率如何. (儿童肥胖症)

blocks.en: 3.5.4 Medical Subject Headings (MeSH) Querying
blocks.zh: 3.5.4 医疗主题标题(MeSH)查询

blocks.en: With all main named entities extracted, another method to link disease entities to their corresponding MeSH (Medical Subject Headings) tree was developed. MeSH is an extensive controlled vocabulary of medical information that provides a standardized terminology for medical terms such as our disease entities [ 50 ]. Therefore, its hierarchical classification of diseases enriches the semantic context of found disease named entities within the realm of medical knowledge.
blocks.zh: 随着所有主要命名实体的采掘,又开发了另一种方法,将疾病实体与其对应的MESH(医学主题树)树联系起来. MeSH是一个广泛的医学信息控制词汇,为我们疾病实体等医学术语提供了标准化术语[50]. 因此,它对疾病的分级分类丰富了在医学知识范围内被命名为疾病的实体的语义背景.

blocks.en: Corresponding MeSH Tree for ’Hypertension’
blocks.zh: 对应的 MeSH 用于“ 循环” 的树 ' ' 说

blocks.en: Apart from enriched insights, including this classification into the final results is also beneficial in the realm of literature indexing. Knowing that the MeSH database is widely used in medical research, researchers can benefit from this feature when seeking publications in a knowledge base.
blocks.zh: 除了丰富见解外,将这种分类纳入最终结果在文献索引编制领域也是有益的。 研究人员知道MESH数据库在医学研究中被广泛使用,在知识库中寻找出版物时可以受益于这一特性.

blocks.en: In terms of our development, the goal was to query and extract the tree displayed in the figure above for each found disease entity in order to provide additional information to potential users who are not familiar with certain medical terms. The Entrez Global Query Cross-Database Search System was utilized as a powerful engine that offers searching in the National Library of Medicine (NLM). Its incorporation into Python was achieved through Biopython , a library that offers freely available Python tools for computational molecular biology, including our live MeSH querying task.
blocks.zh: 就我们的发展而言,目标是查询和提取上图显示的每个发现的疾病实体的树,以便向不熟悉某些医学术语的潜在用户提供更多信息。 Entrez全球查询跨数据库搜索系统被用作一个强大的引擎,在国家医学图书馆提供查询。 它通过Biopython实现与Python的融合,Biopython是一个图书馆,它免费提供用于计算分子生物学的Python工具,包括我们的现场MeSH查询任务.

blocks.en: MeSH Querying - Example Results
blocks.zh: MeSH 查询 - 示例结果

blocks.en: The sub-sample of the query results displayed above exhibits the ability of the library to extract the correct corresponding MeSH tree for each predicted disease entity in a publication. In our implementation, we exclusively extract branches within the hierarchical tree that are positioned in the 2 to 6 range. This ensures the obtention of contextual information related to the disease entity while avoiding the final branches of the tree that usually hold specialized variations of a disease, thus mitigating the risk of misclassification.
blocks.zh: 上面显示的查询结果的子样本显示了库在出版物中提取每个预测疾病实体对应的正确MeSH树的能力. 在执行过程中,我们只提取位于2至6范围内的分层树上的树枝。 这确保了与疾病实体相关的背景信息,同时避免通常持有疾病特殊变异的树的最后分支,从而减轻错误分类的风险.

blocks.en: It should also be noted that the MeSH Querying algorithm is optional in relation to the entirety of the processing pipeline. Given the prompt execution time required for query completion, interested users have the freedom to employ it, without any requirement for its obligatory use.
blocks.zh: 还应指出,MESH查询算法相对于整个处理管道而言是可选的. 鉴于完成查询所需的及时执行时间,感兴趣的用户可以自由使用,而无需强制使用。

blocks.en: 3.5.5 Final Benchmark
blocks.zh: 3.5.5 最后基准

blocks.en: After having established the full document processing pipeline, any global health publication can be passed in as a PDF input for the main named entities to be extracted. To ascertain the capacity of the developed pipeline, a benchmark was constituted. One that included a selection of publications from different health areas was created, in order to test the model’s performance on an unrelated spectrum of global health literature and identify potential areas for refinements. The performance of the model was evaluated in terms of ability to successfully process a publication and output a logical set of main named entities, the quality of extracted named entities with regard to their relatedness to the publication’s central theme, and the total runtime.
blocks.zh: 在建立了完整的文件处理程序之后,任何全球卫生出版物都可以作为PDF输入,供拟提取的主要指定实体使用。 为了确定已开发管道的能力,制订了一个基准。 创建了包括从不同保健领域挑选的出版物在内的一个出版物,以检验该模型在全球保健文献中的表现,并确定可加以改进的领域。 对模型的性能进行了评价,评价的方面包括:能否成功地处理出版物并产出一套符合逻辑的主要命名实体、被提取的被命名实体与出版物中心主题的关联性的质量以及总运行时间。

blocks.en: At this point in time, the pipeline is run through the command line and a sample of the benchmarking results will be presented below via its visualization. Apart from a summarized view of the results displayed on each figure, additional remarks that elucidate the publication’s context and the coherence of named entity extraction in relation to it will be shown.
blocks.zh: 此时,管道通过指令线运行,下文将通过可视化介绍基准结果样本. 除了对每个图上显示的结果作一概述外,还将补充说明该出版物的背景和与该出版物有关的指定实体提取的一致性。

blocks.en: Remark: The global epidemiology of hypertension 26 26 26 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32024986/ , an american publication that provides a statistical analysis on global hypertension in LMICs and HICs. Therefore the extractions of hypertension as a disease by itself, geopolitical named entities, and organizations linked to the study of global hyperentsion (e.g. GBD - Global Burden of Disease), is related to the publication. This is an example of an error-free robust named entity collection, yet a short one given the high count threshold. Remark: Unravelling the knowledge, beliefs, behaviours and concerns of Persons with Haemophilia and their carriers in Senegal 27 27 27 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32666560/ , a qualitative study on haemophilia in Senegal done by researches at the University of Geneva. Apart from the entity results, the extracted MeSH sub-tree of haemophilia corresponds to the said disease and would attach further information to the publication in order to facilitate its indexing. Remark: Baby bonus in Switzerland: Effects on fertility, newborn health, and birth-scheduling 28 28 28 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34076325/ , a publication related more to health economics rather than a focus on a specific disease. This can be reflected on results too, given the numerous organizations. Apart from the mislabeling of a geolocation as a PERSON, the successful recognition of Bundesamt für Sozialversicherungen (Federal Statistical Office in German) should be noted. It is one entirely dependant on POS tags, knowing that the model is trained in English. Remark: Impact of High-Dose-Rate Brachytherapy Training via Telehealth in Low- and Middle-Income Countries 29 29 29 https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC7713515/ , a publication related to a telemedicine training course in brachyterapy in Middle East and Africa. The model’s ability to extract numerous entities related to contributors in the publication should be noted in this case. Apart from that, the mislabeling of RCC (Rayos Contra Cancer, NGO) as a disease should be seen as a shortcoming of CNN models due to their lack of sentence context in comparison to transformer ones.
