Having said that, it would be difficult to define a discrete mathematical formula that determines the excellence of said selection, knowing the subjective nature of language and its context. Although if we would evaluate on a pragmatic criterion that considers as accurate a collection of error-free entities that contextually align with the publication’s primary theme, our pipeline can be considered as ≈ \approx 91% accurate. A lower threshold and a different set of hyperparameters provides a larger yet less robust final list of named entities.
blocks.zh: 从上述结果可以看出一种模式,一种模式显示该模式有能力提供与每份出版物有关的命名实体的最后小精选。 尽管如此,仍难以界定一个单独的数学公式,用以确定上述选择的优异性,同时了解语言的主观性质及其上下文。 虽然我们想用实用标准来评估, 认为收集的无错误实体, 一个较低的阈值和一套不同的超参数提供了一份较大但不太坚固的命名实体最后清单。

blocks.en: Another crucial factor that was considered before the development had started was the total runtime, where a reasonably fast final model was required. A 10-15 page publication requires an average of ≈ \approx 7s to be fully processed on a local machine, a promising result considering that this is developed as potentially parallelizable pipeline able to process numerous documents at once. Having said that, let us take a closer look at how the different parts of the pipeline affect the total runtime distribution to provide a further analysis.
blocks.zh: 在开发开始之前考虑的另一个关键因素是总运行时间,需要相当快的最终模式。 10-15页的出版需要平均 \\\\ 大约 7s 才能在本地机器上完全处理, 考虑到这是一个很有希望的结果, 因为它是潜在的平行的管道 能够同时处理许多文件。 尽管如此,让我们仔细研究管道的不同部分如何影响整个运行时间的分配,以提供进一步的分析。

blocks.en: One can notice that two external methods to the NER pipeline, PDF extraction to text and MeSH Querying, hold the majority of the total runtime. blocks.zh: 人们可以注意到NER管道的两种外部方法,PDF提取到文本和MESH查询,占据了全部运行时间的大部分. 值得注意的是,除了再次强调NER模型的速度外,这一观察为在文本提取和MSH查询中寻找或开发新的替代品提供了进一步探索的基础。

blocks.en: One other potential evaluation method is the comparison of the final extracted main entities to the original keywords found in a publication, if there are any. This would directly compare our model to a handcrafted selection of keywords by the original authors.
blocks.zh: 另一个潜在的评价方法是将最后提取的主要实体与出版物中发现的原始关键词进行比较,如果有的话。 这将直接将我们的模型与原作者手工选择的关键词进行比较。

It demonstrates the model’s ability to provide named entities that function as more focused and contextual keywords, intricately connected to the publication’s content, rather than its general topics. This granularity would provide a deeper document categorization that would facilitate indexing in a knowledge base.
blocks.zh: 上述可视化的比较实例来自以下出版物的结果:瑞士的COVID-19和列支敦士登的COVID-19:牙医认识、保护措施和经济影响跨部门调查 30 30 30 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/33291659。 它表明该模型有能力提供一些被点名的实体,这些实体作为重点更加突出、背景更加紧凑的关键词,与出版物的内容密不可分,而不是其一般专题。 这种颗粒性将提供一个更深入的文件分类,有助于在知识库中编制索引。

blocks.en: Having said that, original keywords in a document are typically present to facilitate literature indexing and tend to align with broader general topics. Therefore, another NLP approach, distinct from NER yet of a lower significance to the project, was explored. An approach with the same objectives in mind that dove in the realm of automatic multi-label topic classification.
blocks.zh: 尽管如此,文件中的原始关键词通常是为了便利文献索引,并倾向于与更广泛的一般专题保持一致。 因此,探索了另一种NLP方法,有别于对项目意义较低的NER。 与自动多标签专题分类领域的目标相同。

blocks.en: 4 Multi-Label Topic Classification
blocks.zh: 4 多标签主题分类

blocks.en:
Topic classification is another natural language processing task that involves labelling a given textual content with the corresponding topic that it represents, essentially text categorization [ 51 ]. Text categorization stands as a macro-reading approach that grasps the overall theme of the content as opposed to named entity recognition that takes a micro-reading approach
labelling each token in a sentence with its individual tag [ 52 ]. Therefore, it can be considered a more forgiving approach as it doesn’t require the pinpoint accuracy of NER but rather an accurate theme that is related to the content.
blocks.zh:
主题分类是另一项自然语言处理任务,涉及将某一文本内容与它所代表的相应主题进行标签,基本上是文本分类[51]. 文本分类是一种宏观阅读方法,它掌握内容的总主题,而不是采用微观阅读方法的命名实体识别
在句子中标注每个符号,并标注其单个标记[52]. 因此,它可以被认为是一种更宽容的方法,因为它并不要求NER的精确性,而是一个与内容相关的准确主题。

For example, the sentence S = S= "Recent advancements in AI have revolutionized robotic surgery and paved the way for more precise procedures" provides a more nuanced categorization if it is assigned to both labels t 1 t_{1} = "Artificial Intelligence" and t 2 t_{2} = "Medical Surgery" , rather than a singular one.

blocks.en: Apart from providing a more sophisticated and detailed categorization system, it is easily understood from both equations that multi-label topic classification provides for a more challenging task. It is a task that has to deal with trending challenges such as relationship between labels, presence of imbalanced labels, and high dimensionality of the output [ 53 ].
blocks.zh: 除了提供更精密和详细的分类系统之外,从两个方程式中都很容易理解,多标签专题分类提供了更具挑战性的任务。 这是一项必须应对趋势性挑战的任务,如标签之间的关系、标签不平衡的存在以及产出的高度维度[53]。

blocks.en: There exist a variety of neural and pre-neural approaches to this problem such as logistic regression, k-nearest neighbours, SVMs for multi-label classification, classifier chains, etc [ 53 ]. However, our limited amount of training data in addition to the requirement of obtaining a fast and accurate topic classification pipeline able to be merged with the NER one shifted the focus towards few-shot and zero shot classification methods.
blocks.zh: 在这个问题上存在着多种神经和神经前方法,如物流回归,k-近邻,SVMs用于多标签分类,分类链等[53]. 然而,我们有限的培训数据,除了要求获得一个能够与NER 1合并的快速和准确的专题分类管道之外,将重点转向了几发和零发的分类方法。

blocks.en: 4.1 Training a Classifier
blocks.zh: 4.1 培训分类器

blocks.en: Knowing the nature of our task as a supervised learning one, we needed to provide pairs of topics and samples to any potential few-shot classification model, as zero shot models do not require any training. We opted out to the creation of a custom dataset that offered a set of labels T T and samples that are highly relatable to the nature of global health publications. This was a choice made to avoid high-dimensionality challenges that established state-of-the-art databases with thousands of labels such as EUR-Lex 31 31 31 HuggingFace - EUR-Lex Dataset provide.
blocks.zh: 了解我们作为一个受监督的学习者的任务的性质,我们需要向任何潜在的几发分级模型提供一对主题和样本,因为零射线模型不需要任何训练. 我们选择建立一个定制数据集,提供一套与全球卫生出版物性质高度可重复的TT标签和样本。 这是为了避免高维度挑战而做出的选择,这种挑战建立了具有数千个标签的先进的数据库,如EUR-Lex 31 31 HuggingFace - EUR-Lex Dataset提供。

blocks.en: Labelled Data - Topic/Samples Examples
blocks.zh: 标签数据 - 专题/实例

blocks.en: The dataset was generated by including 50 50 samples for each topic label, handcrafted samples that aimed to avoid repetition and ambiguity. Henceforth, this type of design was a choice made to exclusively evaluate the classification models on sentences that are related to our project and would normally be found in global digital health publications, rather than general ones.
blocks.zh: 生成数据集的方法是,每个专题标签都包括50个样本,即旨在避免重复和含糊的手工样本。 今后,这种设计是专门评价与我们的项目有关的句子的分类模式的一种选择,通常见于全球数字保健出版物,而不是一般出版物。

blocks.en: Knowing that state-of-the-art transformer models are data-hungry to a degree that makes it very difficult or impossible to train one from scratch, few-shot learning models (FSL) stand as a great alternative that is generalizable to multi-label classification downstream tasks [ 54 ]. It adheres to a lack of data through the design of models that require only handful of annotated examples in order to be fine-tuned to any set of topic labels, as long as it’s annotated.
blocks.zh: 了解最先进的变压器模型是数据饥饿,以至于很难或不可能从零开始训练一个变压器模型(FSL),几发学习模型(FSL)就是一个伟大的替代品,对于多标签分类的下游任务是通用的[54]. 它通过设计只需要少数附加说明的例子的模型来坚持缺乏数据,以便根据任何一组主题标签进行微调,只要它附加说明。

blocks.en: Our design of the labelled dataset is adapted to the prompt-learning method of FSL models, a method that provides examples in the forms of prompts to a model to guide its predictions during inference. In spaCy , the library Classy Classification 32 32 32 https://spacy.io/universe/project/classyclassification was selected as one that offers this feature in spaCy models. Specifically, the code snippet introduces a new text_categorizer pipe to our existing NER model, a pipe that utilizes a chosen pretrained sentence transformer FSL model. This design makes the entire pipeline able to classify topics too, alongside its main named entity recognition functionality, hence why it was chosen as the first approach.
blocks.zh: 我们的标注数据集设计适应了FSL模型的即时学习方法,这种方法以提示形式为模型提供实例,指导模型在推论期间的预测. 校对:Soup 模特儿们 具体地说,代码片段将一个新的文本_分类器管道引入我们现有的NER模型,这个管道使用选定的预训句式变压器FSL模型. 这种设计使得整个管道也能够连同其主要命名的实体识别功能一起对主题进行分类,因此选择了第一个方法。

blocks.en: The results above evidenced the potential shortcomings of the few-shot classification model in the predictions of a test set designed for single label topic classification as an initial accuracy testing method. We arrived at the conclusion that the reliance solely on few-shot models falls short on making predictions withing the context of the requirement of this project and an alternative must be explored.
blocks.zh: 以上结果证明,在为单一标签主题分类设计的测试集的预测中,作为初始精度测试方法的几发分类模型可能存在缺陷。 我们得出的结论是,仅仅依靠几发模型还不足以根据该项目的要求作出预测,必须探索其他办法。

blocks.en: Even though the displayed sample of results showcases accurate predictions at first sight, it additionally reveals clear signs of overfitting in relation to the few-shot input. Specifically, overfitting is determined by the fact that the model’s decisions are often driven by the limited word-by-word examples it was trained on. This leads to a substandard generalization to unseen data and can be observed through the imbalanced and overly confident determinations (e.g. a number of predictions with a probability of 1.0 1.0 , on account of correlating certain words in the sentence query and the train set). An outcome that prompts us to consider the presence of the "short-term memory loss" phenomena, where the model forgets contextual information learned at first training.
blocks.zh: 尽管所展示的结果样本一见钟情地展现出准确的预测,但它还进一步揭示出与几弹输入相比过于吻合的明显迹象. 具体地说,过于吻合的决定因素是,模型的决定常常是由它所接受的有限逐字实例所驱动的。 这导致不达标的泛化为隐形数据,并且可以通过不平衡和过度自信的判断来观察(例如,由于句子查询和列车集中某些单词的关联,一些概率为1.01.0的预测). 一个结果促使我们考虑"短期记忆丧失"现象的存在,即模型忘记了在最初训练时学到的背景信息.

blocks.en: These observations might simply be a case of a substandard spaCy library (Classy Classification) in terms of providing an accurate robust text categorization pipeline based on few-shot models. Nevertheless, the increase in algorithmic complexity that multi-label classification introduces makes these observations even more concerning, amplifying the need to explore zero shot models as the other alternative for this task.
blocks.zh: 这些观察可能只是 一个不符合标准的水疗 Cy库(英语:Classy Classy Classy Classy),在几发模型的基础上提供准确的坚固文本分类管道. 尽管如此,多标签分类引入的算法复杂性的提高使得这些观察更加关注,从而加大了探索零镜头模型作为这项任务的另一种选择的必要性.

blocks.en: 4.2 Zero-Shot Classification
blocks.zh: 4.2 零热分类

blocks.en: Zero-shot classifiers stand as one of the most impressive evolutions in natural language processing. They are derived from unsupervised large language models (LLMs) that are trained on a huge amount of data that have accelerated the entire NLP research area through their great leap in performance for a variety of NLP tasks [ 54 ], including ours of multi-label classification. The ability of these models to be fine-tuned to any specific downstreamz task has made this pretrain-finetune paradigm the new approach to NLP tasks outside of research, replacing the more traditional knowledge based and fully supervised methods [ 55 ]. In the context of our specific task, it means having a model able to make multi-label topic predictions on sentences without any prior training, a zero-shot prediction.
blocks.zh: 零镜头分类法是自然语言处理中最令人印象深刻的演化法之一. 它们来源于未经监督的大型语言模型(LLM),这些模型经过大量数据的培训,通过在各种NLP任务[54],包括我们的多标签分类的性能大跃进,加速了整个NLP研究领域. 由于这些模型能够对具体下游任务进行精细调整,使得这种预选精细化的范式成为研究之外NLP任务的新办法,取代了更基于传统知识和充分监督的方法[55]. 就我们的具体任务而言,这意味着有一个模型能够对句子进行多标签主题预测,而无需经过任何事先的训练,即零镜头预测.

blocks.en: Therefore, a general purpose zero-shot model was seen as the most practical for our task, offering a unique solution to projects suffering from a scarcity of data. Apart from the scarcity challenge, the model’s supposed ability to generalize over a variety of categories including topics that it has never seen before made it the natural choice for a domain that demands flexibility across a variety of different topics from multiple domains, such as global digital health.
blocks.zh: 因此,一个通用的零射线模型被视为我们任务中最实际的模式,为数据匮乏的项目提供了一个独特的解决方案。 除了稀缺性挑战之外,该模型假定有能力概括包括它从未见过的题目在内的各种类别,这使它成为对一个领域自然的选择,而这个领域需要从多个领域,如全球数字健康,来灵活处理各种不同的专题。

blocks.en: In development, the Facebook trained BART model on the MultiNLI (MNLI) dataset was loaded in Python through HuggingFace. It excels as a zero-shot sequence classifier based on the NLI-based prediction method, proposed by the work of Yin et al [ 57 ].
blocks.zh: 在开发过程中,Facebook在MultiNLI(MNLI)数据集上培训的BART模型通过HuggingFace在Python上载. 它作为基于NLI的预测方法的零射线序列分类器非常出色,由Yin等人的工作提出[57].

blocks.en: 4.3 Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.3 评价

blocks.en: A more formal test set for both the few-shot and zero-shot classifiers was designed, one that included 1000 handcrafted sentences. For each of one of the 50 topic labels, 20 sentences tagged with the corresponding true label were generated, in order to compute accuracy in a single-label classification scenario. The sentences were crafted with one main central topic in mind that they would have attached as a true label while retaining the potential for broader interpretations and further labelling with other topics.
blocks.zh: 设计了更正式的几发和零发分级的测试集,其中包含1000个手动句子. 对于50个主题标签中的每一个,都生成了20个带有相应真实标签的句子,以便计算单标签分类情景中的准确性. 拟订这些句子时,有一个主要的中心议题是,这些句子本来是作为真正的标签而附加的,同时保留了与其他议题进行更广泛解释和进一步标签的可能性。

blocks.en: Taking the following test sentence as an example: "Through the generous funding of the European Union’s Horizon 2020 program under grant agreement No. 123456, our study investigates the role of artificial intelligence in personalized medicine." , a sentence tagged with Publicly Funded Science as its main topic label to evaluate on a single label scenario. Nevertheless, it stands as a sentence that can be tagged with the label ’Artificial Intelligence’ and ’Digital Health’ in a multi label scenario too.
blocks.zh: 以下列试验句为例: 我们的研究调查人工智能在个性化医学中的作用。 以公共资助科学为主要主题标签, 然而,它是一个句子,在多标签的情景中,可以用 " 人工智能 " 和 " 数字健康 " 标签标记。

blocks.en: Apart from that, 10% of the dataset was intentionally dedicated to adversary sentences meant to trick the model during classification. These are sentences that seem to align with a certain topic at first sight however they harbor altered words intended for misclassification, posing a deeper semantic challenge to the models.
blocks.zh: 除此以外,10%的数据集是故意专用于对口句,意在在分类时欺骗模型. 这些句子在初见之下似乎与某一专题一致,但它们含有意在错误分类的改动词,对模型提出了更深层次的语义挑战。

blocks.en: Even though the few-shot classifier manages to correctly label a simple majority of the sentences, these results prove once again the superiority of LLMs as generalizable zero-shot classifiers in the realm of topic classification too.
blocks.zh: 尽管几发分类器设法正确标注了简单多数的句子,但这些结果再次证明了LLMS作为一般零发分类器在专题分类领域的优越性.

blocks.en: Note: As for the multi label scenario, a certain degree of manual assessment becomes necessary given the subjective nature of contextual importance of labels. For example, given a sentence that mentions both " policy reform " and " climate change " with the the automated algorithm having them both tagged as true and a human annotator that thinks otherwise.
blocks.zh: 注:至于多标签方案,鉴于标签在背景上的重要性的主观性质,有必要进行一定程度的人工评估。 例如,有一句话既提到 " 政策改革 " ,也提到 " 气候变化 " ,自动算法将两者都标记为真实,并且是认为相反的人名注释者。

blocks.en: Zero-Shot Topic Classification - Sample of Results
blocks.zh: 零热专题分类-结果样本

blocks.en: We could take a closer look at the results of the benchmark from the zero-shot classifier’s point of view knowing that it was chosen as the favourite. Despite a few examples of incorrect predictions (again, subjectively thinking ), the performance in multi-labelling a sentence is clear. The selection threshold was a probability of p ≥ 0.7 p\geq 0.7 per topic, therefore these were predictions made with a high level of confidence by the model which exhibits a great contextual understanding from the chosen BERT classifier. Furthermore, I intentionally selected for display above a sample of sentences that represent different domains ranging from human rights, to economy and health. A correct labelling of this selection stands as a sign of the generalization ability of the model no matter the origin of the topic label.
blocks.zh: 我们可以从零射分级者的角度仔细审视基准结果,知道它是被选为最受欢迎的。 尽管有一些不正确的预测的例子(又是主观的思考),在多标签的句子中的性能是明确的. 选择阈值是每个专题0.7 p\geq 0.7页的概率,因此这些是模型以高度信心作出的预测,显示选定的BERT分类器对背景有很大的了解。 此外,我还有意选择将一些代表人权、经济和健康等不同领域的句子放在上面。 这种选择的正确标签表明,无论主题标签的来源如何,模型都具有通用能力。

blocks.en: The zero-shot classifier was adapted to the document processing pipeline of the named entity recognition model, in order to be tested with tagging a full publication instead of singular sentences. Frequency-based filtering of topic predictions was made, the same approach as in the case of NER.
blocks.zh: 零镜头分类器被调整为命名实体识别模型的文档处理管道,以便用标记一个完整的出版物而不是单数句子来测试. 对专题预测进行了频率过滤,与NER相同。

blocks.en: Topic Classification on a Full Document Level
blocks.zh: 全面文件级别专题分类

blocks.en: The final selected topics (most frequent ones) are compatible with the central theme of the publication, keeping in mind that the predictions are made from a pool of only 50 labels. This is a performance that stays true for most of the publications, showing the model’s capability to automatically tag any given publication.
blocks.zh: 最终选题(最常选题)与该出版物的中心主题相容,同时牢记这些预测都是从只有50个标签的集合中作出的. 这种表现对大多数出版物来说都是真实的,表明模型有能力自动标记任何特定出版物。

blocks.en: However , while the NER model requires 2 seconds to process the whole document, the selected zero-shot classifier requires the same 2 seconds to process a single sentence, for a total of 400s second for the full publication using a Nvidia GTX 1650 TI GPU. Therefore, despite the impressing accuracy, zero-shot classifiers come with a computational complexity that is not practical for every application. Such is the case of ours, where the combination of performance and speed were requirements knowing the nature of global health implementations.
blocks.zh: 然而,虽然NER模型需要2秒来处理整个文档,但所选的零镜头分类器需要同样2秒来处理单个句子,使用Nvidia GTX 1650 TI GPU的完整发布总共需要400秒. 因此,尽管有令人印象深刻的准确性,但零镜头分类法具有计算的复杂性,这对每个应用程序来说并不实际。 我们的情况就是如此,业绩和速度的结合是了解全球卫生执行工作的性质的要求。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion & Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5. 讨论和结论

blocks.en: Before jumping to the conclusion, I would like to briefly discuss each of the three making parts of this thesis, separately. These should be seen as reflections in the terms of their effect on the main problem statement, research question, and industry need behind this research journey of the past year. Apart from that, each corresponding natural language processing topic should not be forgotten to be mentioned if it contributed to filling existing gaps in the general research in addition to meeting my initial expectations.
blocks.zh: 在作出结论之前,我想分别简要地讨论这篇论文的三个部分。 应将这些问题视为对主要问题陈述、研究问题和工业界在过去一年这一研究之旅背后需要产生的影响的反思。 除此之外,不应忘记每个相应的自然语言处理专题,如果它有助于填补一般性研究中现有的空白,并满足我最初的期望。

blocks.en: word2vec
blocks.zh: 单词2vec

blocks.en: Initially chosen as a word embedding method that can discover intricate similarities between words based on their vector representation in a computationally efficient manner, word2vec still stands as a fast way to embed words. For the majority of tags, the real semantic proximity between words directly corresponded to the cosine similarity between vectors in the mathematical space.
blocks.zh: 最初选作一个词嵌入法,能够根据它们的矢量表示以计算效率的方式发现词之间的复杂相似性,word2vec仍然是嵌入词的快速方式. 对于大多数标记,词之间的真实语义近似直接对应数学空间中向量之间的余弦相似性.

blocks.en: Comparing the same word2vec model against itself in different scenarios of being trained with a larger corpora each time gave us insights in the capturing of localized nuances. An insufficient corpora results in an insufficient model while a large corpora with a vocabulary size in the billions doesn’t capture localized contexts and loses the main point of automatic tag discovery. If you want to discover underlying contextual insights of a certain domain in a certain region, train the word2vec model with publications of that domain and region exclusively.
blocks.zh: 将同一个单词2vec模型与自己相比,在不同的情景中,每一次都与一个更大的蝎子一起接受训练,这使我们对捕捉局部细微差别有了深刻的认识。 无法捕捉本地背景, 失去自动发现标记的要点。 如果您想在某个地区发现某个领域的内在背景,请专门用该领域和区域的出版物来培训单词模式。

blocks.en: Reflecting on the initial choice of using word2vec as a word embedding alternative, a further work would have included ELMo as another more novel word embedding method that potentially adresses the limitations of word2vec. Alternatively, considering the landscape of NLP research community and the development of contextual models such as BERT, traditional methods such as word2vec might stand as a relic of the past [ 58 ].
blocks.zh: 在思考最初选择使用word2vec作为嵌入式替代词时,进一步的工作会包括ELMo,作为另一种更新颖的词嵌入法,它可能满足word2vec的局限性. 或者,考虑到NLP研究界的地貌和BERT等背景模型的发展,Word2vec等传统方法可能成为过去的遗迹[58].

blocks.en: Named Entity Recognition
blocks.zh: 命名实体识别

blocks.en: As the main NLP study area of this project, named entity recognition (NER) proved itself as a fundamental task of entity information extraction in different domains and natures of text. My decision to choose NER for this project and for my further research opportunities is based on its remarkable customizability and adaptability to tasks.
blocks.zh: 作为该项目的主要NLP研究领域,被命名的实体识别(NER)被证明是实体在不同领域和文本性质中信息提取的基本任务. 我决定为这个项目选择NER 和为我的进一步研究机会, 是基于它非常适合和适应任务。

blocks.en: Adaptability to any task and domain that involves entities can be observed in the ability to train any NER model to recognize in language any type of given entity label as long as it has the required labelled data to train for the recognition. This was perceptible in our task from the variety of entity labels ranging from locations, geopolitical entities, global and national laws, to medical diseases.
blocks.zh: 任何涉及实体的任务和域的适应性都可以观察到,只要有所需的标签数据来培训识别,就能够训练任何NER模型,以语言识别任何类型的特定实体标签。 这在我们的任务中是可以理解的,从地点、地缘政治实体、全球和国家法律到医疗疾病等各种实体标签。

blocks.en: Frameworks such as spaCy support this venue of flexibility through their model’s possibility to be trained from scratch or fine-tuned on domain-specific labels, achieving adequate entity extraction results in the process. Fine-tuning a pretrained off-the-shelf model to recognize domain-specific entities should be the norm of utilization of named entity recognition pipelines, as it is for the majority of other NLP downstream tasks.
blocks.zh: 温泉等框架 Cy支持这种灵活性的场所,因为它的模型有可能从头到尾接受培训,或对特定域的标签进行微调,从而在这一过程中取得足够的实体提取结果。 精细调整预先培训的现成模式,以识别特定域的实体,这应当成为使用指定实体识别管道的规范,正如其他大多数NLP下游任务一样。

blocks.en: Despite the explosion in popularity of transformer-based and large language models, the industry need speed requirement of this project showcased the practicality of another type of network, convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The rapid processing of documents without compromising accuracy aligned with the practical nature of the task where timely information retrieval was required, as imagined and would be required in a remote regional health implementation.
blocks.zh: 尽管基于变压器和大型语言模型的流行程度大增,但业界需要这个项目的速度要求展示了另一种类型的网络,即革命神经网络(CNNs)的实用性. 迅速处理文件而不损害准确性,符合任务的实际性质,因为需要及时检索信息,这是在遥远的区域保健执行中所想象和需要的。

blocks.en: Apart from the performance and customizability of NER, some concerns and potential further works were raised during research. Despite the model’s flexibility on entity labels, the lack of public labeled data remains a major difficulty. While there exist datasets for the main most popular entity types (organizations, locations, biomedical entities), other specific entity types (e.g. Global Health Laws) suffer from a lack of labelled data. Additionally, the document processing pipeline suffered from PDF text extractors in both information loss and total runtime given that incorrect text extractions result in a data loss which confuses any type of model, including the NER one. Therefore, increasing the accuracy text extraction methods should be seen as another potential future research area.
blocks.zh: 除了NER的性能和可定制性外,研究期间还提出了一些关切和潜在的进一步工作。 尽管模型在实体标签上具有灵活性,但缺乏公共标签数据仍然是一大困难。 虽然有关于最受欢迎的主要实体类型(组织、地点、生物医学实体)的数据集,但其他具体实体类型(如全球卫生法)缺乏标注数据。 此外,文件处理管道在信息损失和总运行时间方面都受到PDF文本提取器的影响,因为不正确的文本提取导致数据损失,混淆了包括NER模式在内的任何类型的模型。 因此,提高文本提取方法的准确性应被看作是未来另一个潜在的研究领域。

blocks.en: Topic Classification
blocks.zh: 专题分类

blocks.en: In any case where we need to label a certain piece of information content for retrieval purposes, automatic topic classification should be explored as a task. An accurate classification that is able to categorize content into predefined topics facilitates information search, enhances knowledge, and provides a better user experience. Knowing that content (especially textual) has contextual nuances and cannot always be labelled with only a single topic, multi-label classification should be a prerequisite.
blocks.zh: 在任何情况下,如果需要为检索目的给某一条信息内容贴上标签,就应作为一项任务探索自动专题分类。 能够将内容分类为预定义主题的准确分类有助于信息搜索,增强知识,并提供更好的用户体验. 了解内容(特别是文字)有上下文的细微差别,不能总是只用一个单一的主题来标注,多标签分类应该是先决条件.

blocks.en: Despite the numerous traditional statistical methods and models to approach a classification task, the more modern performant large language models are recommended to be chosen in cases where the task isn’t the focal point of the research such as this one. The comparison of two modern NLP evolutions such as the few-shot and general zero-shot classifiers proved the superiority of the latter in single and multi-label classification tasks.
blocks.zh: 尽管有许多传统的统计方法与模式来进行分类任务, 对两个现代NLP演化的比较,如几发和一般的零发分类法,证明了后者在单一和多标签分类任务中的优越性.

blocks.en: The only risen concern behind the utilization of resource intensive models such as LLMs is related to their computational and time complexity, substandard in comparison to the NER model. Consequently, further work to tackle this problem should be explored in the form of more lightweight architectures or other model compression techniques.
blocks.zh: 使用LLMs等资源密集型模型的唯一令人关切的问题是其计算和时间的复杂性,与NER模型相比不合格。 因此,应该以更轻的建筑或其他模型压缩技术的形式探讨解决这个问题的进一步工作。

blocks.en: Conclusion
blocks.zh: 结论

blocks.en: Through this natural language processing’s odyssey, we have unveiled the importance and adaptability of NLP tasks to any problem related to language and text, be it for research or industrial applications. What started as a task to annotate global digital health publications for a knowledge base, turned into a theoretical research of three pivotal NLP areas.
blocks.zh: 通过这种自然语言处理法,我们揭示了NLP任务对于任何语言和文字问题的重要性和适应性,无论是研究还是工业应用。 最初的任务是为知识库提供全球数字保健出版物的注释,后来变成了对三个关键的NLP领域的理论研究。

blocks.en: Word embeddings such as word2vec remain a prominent way to grasp how text is transformed into a mathematical representations, but recent developments based on contextual embeddings and transformers might have left them in the past. Named Entity Recognition (NER) stands as one of the most important and customizable task of NLP, allowing the recognition of any thought entity type as long as it has been trained with the proper labelled data to do so. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) still stand as a balance between speed and accuracy, achieving named entity extraction of entire research publications in under 2s. Topic Classification should be part of any system that contains information retrieval of textual content, where multi-label classification provides a more efficient and contextually complete information. Modern large language models adaptable to the task with minimal (few-shot) or no (zero-shot) fine-tuning should be prioritized because of their accuracy, keeping in mind the computational complexity behind them.
blocks.zh: 文字嵌入,如word2vec,仍然是掌握文本如何转化为数学表达的突出方式,但基于上下文嵌入和变压器的近期发展可能已经把它们留在过去. 命名的实体识别(NER)是NLP最重要和最定制的任务之一,只要经过适当的标注数据的培训,就可以认可任何思想实体类型。 革命神经网络(CNNs)在速度和准确性之间仍然保持平衡,实现了2岁以下所有研究出版物的命名实体提取. 专题分类应是包含文字内容信息检索的任何系统的一部分,其中多标签分类提供更有效和更符合具体情况的完整信息。 适合任务的现代大语言模型,只要最小(few-shot)或没有(0-shot)微调,就应当因其准确性而优先,同时牢记后面的计算复杂性.

blocks.en: Further work and research should be put towards recent developments in NLP such as generative models, zero-shot classifiers, and multi-modal language models. In a rapidly advancing field such as the one of AI, these might be the models of the future and turn obsolete anything released prior to them.
blocks.zh: 应进一步努力和研究NLP的近期发展,如基因模型、零镜头分类器和多模式语言模型。 在一个迅速进步的领域,如AI领域,这些可能是未来的模型,并让之前发布的东西过时。
